```ts
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatButtonModule } from '@angular/material/button';
import { MatCheckboxModule } from '@angular/material/checkbox';
import { MAT_DIALOG_DATA, MatDialog, MatDialogActions, MatDialogContent, MatDialogRef, MatDialogTitle } from '@angular/material/dialog';
import { MatFormFieldModule } from '@angular/material/form-field';
import { MatIconModule } from '@angular/material/icon';
import { MatInputModule } from '@angular/material/input';
import { MatProgressBarModule } from '@angular/material/progress-bar';
import { Observable, firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';
import {
  BulkSwapResult,
  CostingApi,
  MaterialCost,
  SwapPreview,
  SwapPreviewRow,
  UnitOfMeasure,
  WhereUsedKind,
  WhereUsedReport,
  recipeCostOf,
} from '../../core/costing/costing.api';
import { errorMessage } from '../../core/http/error-message';
import { Company } from '../../core/settings/company';
import { MoneyPipe } from '../../core/ui/money.pipe';
import { NotifyService } from '../../core/ui/notify.service';
import { InfoTip } from './info-tip';
import { MaterialPicker } from './material-picker';

// The item to start from: the stock card's, when opened from it.
export interface BulkSwapData {
  fromMaterialId?: string | null;
}

export const unitShort: Record<UnitOfMeasure, string> = { Gram: 'g', Millilitre: 'ml', Piece: 'pc' };

export const usedKindLabels: Record<WhereUsedKind, { en: string; ar: string; icon: string }> = {
  Dish: { en: 'Dish', ar: 'طبق', icon: 'restaurant' },
  OffMenuRecipe: { en: 'Off the menu', ar: 'خارج المنيو', icon: 'science' },
  PrepItem: { en: 'Prep item', ar: 'مصنّع', icon: 'soup_kitchen' },
};

const steps = [
  { en: 'Old item', ar: 'الخامة القديمة' },
  { en: 'New item', ar: 'الخامة الجديدة' },
  { en: 'Conversion', ar: 'معامل التحويل' },
  { en: 'Preview & choose', ar: 'معاينة واختيار الوصفات' },
];

// The bulk material swap (معالج الاستبدال الشامل للخامات): the old item, the new one, how much of the
// new replaces each unit of the old (1:1 unless the chef says), then every recipe and prep item
// with the old item on it, as the swap would leave it, each ticked unless it cannot be swapped now.
// Swapped together or not at all; closes with what was done.
@Component({
  selector: 'app-bulk-swap-dialog',
  imports: [
    DecimalPipe,
    FormsModule,
    InfoTip,
    MatButtonModule,
    MatCheckboxModule,
    MatDialogActions,
    MatDialogContent,
    MatDialogTitle,
    MatFormFieldModule,
    MatIconModule,
    MatInputModule,
    MatProgressBarModule,
    MaterialPicker,
    MoneyPipe,
  ],
  template: `
    <h2 mat-dialog-title>Bulk swap material <span class="inline-ar">استبدال خامة شامل</span></h2>
    <mat-dialog-content>
      <ol class="steps" aria-label="Steps">
        @for (s of steps; track s.en; let i = $index) {
          <li [class.current]="step() === i + 1" [class.done]="step() > i + 1" [attr.aria-current]="step() === i + 1 ? 'step' : null">
            <span class="dot">{{ step() > i + 1 ? '✓' : i + 1 }}</span>
            <span>{{ s.en }}<span class="ar">{{ s.ar }}</span></span>
          </li>
        }
      </ol>
      @if (busy()) {
        <mat-progress-bar mode="indeterminate" />
      }
      @if (error(); as e) {
        <p class="error" role="alert">{{ e }}</p>
      }

      @switch (step()) {
        @case (1) {
          <p class="lead">The item to take off the recipes · الخامة المُراد استبدالها</p>
          <app-material-picker [materials]="materials()" [value]="from()" (valueChange)="pickFrom($event)" label="Old item · الخامة القديمة" />
          @if (usage(); as u) {
            <p class="usage">
              @if (onRecipes() === 0 && onPrep() === 0) {
                <mat-icon aria-hidden="true">info</mat-icon> {{ u.material }} is on no recipe itself{{ u.rows.length ? ', only inside prep items' : '' }}: nothing to swap.
              } @else {
                <mat-icon aria-hidden="true">receipt_long</mat-icon>
                On {{ onRecipes() }} {{ onRecipes() === 1 ? 'recipe' : 'recipes' }} and {{ onPrep() }} {{ onPrep() === 1 ? 'prep item' : 'prep items' }}
                · في {{ onRecipes() }} وصفة و{{ onPrep() }} مصنّع
              }
            </p>
          }
        }
        @case (2) {
          <p class="lead">What goes on instead of {{ fromItem()?.name }} · الخامة الجديدة</p>
          <app-material-picker [materials]="candidates()" [value]="to()" (valueChange)="to.set($event)" label="New item · الخامة الجديدة" />
          @if (fromItem(); as f) {
            <div class="pair">
              <div><span class="muted small">Old · القديمة</span><strong>{{ f.name }}</strong><span class="muted small">{{ priceOf(f) }}</span></div>
              <mat-icon aria-hidden="true">arrow_forward</mat-icon>
              @if (toItem(); as t) {
                <div><span class="muted small">New · الجديدة</span><strong>{{ t.name }}</strong><span class="muted small">{{ priceOf(t) }}</span></div>
              } @else {
                <div class="muted">Choose the new item</div>
              }
            </div>
          }
        }
        @case (3) {
          @if (fromItem(); as f) {
            @if (toItem(); as t) {
              <p class="lead">How much of the new item replaces the old · معامل التحويل <app-info-tip tip="bsRatio" /></p>
              <div class="ratio">
                <span>Replace</span>
                <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="qty">
                  <input matInput type="number" min="0" step="any" [ngModel]="base()" (ngModelChange)="base.set($event)" aria-label="Old quantity" />
                  <span matTextSuffix>&nbsp;{{ units[f.unit] }}</span>
                </mat-form-field>
                <span>of <strong>{{ f.name }}</strong> with</span>
                <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="qty">
                  <input matInput type="number" min="0" step="any" [ngModel]="replacement()" (ngModelChange)="replacement.set($event)" aria-label="New quantity" />
                  <span matTextSuffix>&nbsp;{{ units[t.unit] }}</span>
                </mat-form-field>
                <span>of <strong>{{ t.name }}</strong></span>
              </div>
              <p class="muted">
                @if (ratio(); as r) {
                  Ratio {{ r | number: '1.0-4' }} · each {{ units[f.unit] }} of the old becomes {{ r | number: '1.0-4' }} {{ units[t.unit] }} of the new.
                } @else {
                  Both quantities are more than nothing, the ratio at most 1,000.
                }
              </p>
              @if (f.unit !== t.unit) {
                <p class="warn"><mat-icon aria-hidden="true">warning</mat-icon> {{ f.name }} is in {{ units[f.unit] }}, {{ t.name }} in {{ units[t.unit] }}: check the ratio · الوحدات مختلفة، راجع المعامل.</p>
              }
              <button mat-button type="button" (click)="resetRatio()" [disabled]="ratio() === 1"><mat-icon>restart_alt</mat-icon> 1 : 1</button>
            }
          }
        }
        @case (4) {
          @if (preview(); as p) {
            <p class="lead">
              {{ p.from.name }} → {{ p.to.name }} at {{ p.ratio | number: '1.0-4' }}
              <span class="muted">· untick what should keep {{ p.from.name }}</span>
            </p>
            <div class="table-wrap">
              <table class="grid swap">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th class="check">
                      <mat-checkbox [checked]="allChosen()" [indeterminate]="someChosen()" [disabled]="!choosable().length" (change)="chooseAll($event.checked)"
                        aria-label="Choose every recipe" />
                    </th>
                    <th>Recipe<span class="ar">الوصفة</span></th>
                    <th class="num">Current {{ units[p.from.unit] }}<span class="ar">الكمية الحالية</span></th>
                    <th class="num">New {{ units[p.to.unit] }}<span class="ar">الكمية الجديدة</span></th>
                    <th class="num">Old cost<span class="ar">التكلفة القديمة</span></th>
                    <th class="num">New cost<span class="ar">التكلفة الجديدة</span></th>
                    <th class="num">Cost delta <app-info-tip tip="bsDelta" /><span class="ar">فرق التكلفة</span></th>
                    <th class="num">Food cost %<span class="ar">نسبة التكلفة</span></th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  @for (row of p.rows; track row.id) {
                    <tr [class.off]="!isChosen(row)" [class.blocked]="row.blocked">
                      <td class="check">
                        <mat-checkbox [checked]="isChosen(row)" [disabled]="!!row.blocked" (change)="choose(row, $event.checked)" [attr.aria-label]="'Swap in ' + row.name" />
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        <span class="kind" [class]="row.kind"><mat-icon aria-hidden="true">{{ kinds[row.kind].icon }}</mat-icon> {{ kinds[row.kind].en }}</span>
                        <strong>{{ row.name }}</strong>
                        <div class="muted small">
                          {{ row.itemCode ? row.itemCode + ' · ' : '' }}{{ makes(row) }}
                        </div>
                        @if (row.blocked) {
                          <div class="blocked-note"><mat-icon aria-hidden="true">lock</mat-icon> {{ row.blocked }}</div>
                        } @else if (row.fromNextBatch) {
                          <div class="muted small"><mat-icon class="tiny" aria-hidden="true">schedule</mat-icon> from the next batch · من الدفعة القادمة</div>
                        }
                      </td>
                      <td class="num">{{ row.oldQuantity | number: '1.0-3' }}</td>
                      <td class="num strong">
                        {{ row.newQuantity | number: '1.0-3' }}
                        @if (row.merged) {
                          <div class="muted small">added to what is there</div>
                        }
                      </td>
                      <td class="num">{{ row.oldCost === null ? '—' : (row.oldCost | money) }}</td>
                      <td class="num">{{ row.newCost === null ? '—' : (row.newCost | money) }}</td>
                      <td class="num delta" [class.up]="(row.costDelta ?? 0) > 0" [class.down]="(row.costDelta ?? 0) < 0">{{ signed(row.costDelta) }}</td>
                      <td class="num nowrap">{{ fc(row.oldFoodCostPercent) }} → {{ fc(row.newFoodCostPercent) }}</td>
                    </tr>
                  } @empty {
                    <tr><td colspan="8" class="muted">No recipe or prep item has {{ p.from.name }} on it.</td></tr>
                  }
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            <p class="muted small">A dish's cost is a portion's; a prep item's, a batch's.</p>

            @if (p.knockOn.length) {
              <h3>Also moving through prep items · أطباق تتأثر عبر المصنّعات <app-info-tip tip="bsKnockOn" /></h3>
              <div class="table-wrap">
                <table class="grid knock-on">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th>Dish<span class="ar">الطبق</span></th>
                      <th>Through<span class="ar">عبر</span></th>
                      <th class="num">Old cost<span class="ar">القديمة</span></th>
                      <th class="num">New cost<span class="ar">الجديدة</span></th>
                      <th class="num">Cost delta<span class="ar">الفرق</span></th>
                      <th class="num">Food cost %<span class="ar">نسبة التكلفة</span></th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    @for (k of p.knockOn; track k.id) {
                      <tr>
                        <td>
                          <strong>{{ k.name }}</strong>
                          @if (k.fromNextBatch) {
                            <div class="muted small">from the next batch · من الدفعة القادمة</div>
                          }
                        </td>
                        <td>{{ k.via.join(', ') }}</td>
                        <td class="num">{{ k.oldCost === null ? '—' : (k.oldCost | money) }}</td>
                        <td class="num">{{ k.newCost === null ? '—' : (k.newCost | money) }}</td>
                        <td class="num delta" [class.up]="(k.costDelta ?? 0) > 0" [class.down]="(k.costDelta ?? 0) < 0">{{ signed(k.costDelta) }}</td>
                        <td class="num nowrap">{{ fc(k.oldFoodCostPercent) }} → {{ fc(k.newFoodCostPercent) }}</td>
                      </tr>
                    }
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            }
          }
        }
      }
    </mat-dialog-content>
    <mat-dialog-actions>
      <span class="summary muted">
        @if (step() === 4 && preview()) {
          {{ chosenRecipes().length }} {{ chosenRecipes().length === 1 ? 'recipe' : 'recipes' }} and {{ chosenPrep().length }}
          {{ chosenPrep().length === 1 ? 'prep item' : 'prep items' }} chosen
        }
      </span>
      <button mat-button type="button" (click)="close()" [disabled]="saving()">Cancel</button>
      @if (step() > 1) {
        <button mat-stroked-button type="button" (click)="back()" [disabled]="saving()"><mat-icon>arrow_back</mat-icon> Back</button>
      }
      @if (step() < 4) {
        <button mat-flat-button type="button" class="next" (click)="next()" [disabled]="!canNext() || busy()">Next <mat-icon iconPositionEnd>arrow_forward</mat-icon></button>
      } @else {
        <button mat-flat-button type="button" class="swap" (click)="swap()" [disabled]="!canSwap()">
          <mat-icon>swap_horiz</mat-icon> Swap · استبدال
        </button>
      }
    </mat-dialog-actions>
  `,
  styleUrl: './costing.scss',
  styles: `
    .steps {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px 18px;
      margin: 0 0 16px;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;

      li {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 8px;
        color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant);
        font: var(--mat-sys-label-large);
      }
      .dot {
        display: inline-grid;
        place-items: center;
        width: 24px;
        height: 24px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--mat-sys-surface-container-high);
        font: var(--mat-sys-label-medium);
      }
      li.current {
        color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface);
        .dot {
          background: var(--mat-sys-primary);
          color: var(--mat-sys-on-primary);
        }
      }
      li.done .dot {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-ok) 18%, transparent);
        color: var(--app-ok);
      }
      .ar {
        display: inline;
        margin-inline-start: 6px;
      }
    }
    .lead {
      margin: 0 0 12px;
      font: var(--mat-sys-title-small);
    }
    .usage,
    .warn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      margin: 12px 0 0;
    }
    .warn {
      color: var(--app-warn);
    }
    .pair {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-top: 16px;

      div {
        display: grid;
        gap: 2px;
        min-width: 160px;
      }
    }
    .ratio {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px 10px;
    }
    .qty {
      width: 130px;
    }
    .check {
      width: 40px;
    }
    tr.off td:not(.check) {
      color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant);
    }
    tr.off td.delta {
      opacity: 0.6;
    }
    .kind {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      margin-inline-end: 6px;
      padding: 0 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font: var(--mat-sys-label-small);
      line-height: 20px;
      background: var(--mat-sys-surface-container-high);

      mat-icon {
        width: 14px;
        height: 14px;
        font-size: 14px;
      }
    }
    .blocked-note {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      color: var(--app-warn);
      font: var(--mat-sys-body-small);

      mat-icon {
        width: 14px;
        height: 14px;
        font-size: 14px;
      }
    }
    .tiny {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      font-size: 12px;
      vertical-align: middle;

})
export class BulkSwapDialog implements OnDestroy {
  private readonly data = inject<BulkSwapData | null>(MAT_DIALOG_DATA, { optional: true });
  private readonly api = inject(CostingApi);
  private readonly company = inject(Company);
  private readonly notify = inject(NotifyService);
  private readonly ref = inject(MatDialogRef<BulkSwapDialog, BulkSwapResult | undefined>);

  protected readonly steps = steps;
  protected readonly units = unitShort;
  protected readonly kinds = usedKindLabels;
  protected readonly step = signal(1);
  protected readonly materials = signal<MaterialCost[]>([]);
  protected readonly from = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly to = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly usage = signal<WhereUsedReport | null>(null);
  // "Replace base of the old with replacement of the new".
  protected readonly base = signal<number | null>(100);
  protected readonly replacement = signal<number | null>(100);
  protected readonly preview = signal<SwapPreview | null>(null);
  // The rows chosen, by id; null until the first preview ticks them.
  protected readonly chosen = signal<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
  protected readonly busy = signal(false);
  protected readonly saving = signal(false);
  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  private refreshTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private sequence = 0;

  protected readonly fromItem = computed(() => this.materials().find((m) => m.id === this.from()) ?? null);
  protected readonly toItem = computed(() => this.materials().find((m) => m.id === this.to()) ?? null);
  // Any item but the old one.
  protected readonly candidates = computed(() => this.materials().filter((m) => m.id !== this.from()));
  protected readonly onRecipes = computed(() => (this.usage()?.rows ?? []).filter((r) => r.kind !== 'PrepItem' && r.quantity !== null).length);
  protected readonly onPrep = computed(() => (this.usage()?.rows ?? []).filter((r) => r.kind === 'PrepItem' && r.quantity !== null).length);
  protected readonly ratio = computed(() => {
    const [base, replacement] = [Number(this.base()), Number(this.replacement())];
    if (!(base > 0) || !(replacement > 0)) {
      return null;
    }
    const ratio = Math.round((replacement / base) * 1e6) / 1e6;
    return ratio > 0 && ratio <= 1000 ? ratio : null;
  });
  protected readonly choosable = computed(() => (this.preview()?.rows ?? []).filter((r) => !r.blocked));
  protected readonly chosenRecipes = computed(() => this.choosable().filter((r) => r.kind !== 'PrepItem' && this.chosen().has(r.id)).map((r) => r.id));
  protected readonly chosenPrep = computed(() => this.choosable().filter((r) => r.kind === 'PrepItem' && this.chosen().has(r.id)).map((r) => r.id));
  protected readonly allChosen = computed(() => this.choosable().length > 0 && this.choosable().every((r) => this.chosen().has(r.id)));
  protected readonly someChosen = computed(() => !this.allChosen() && this.choosable().some((r) => this.chosen().has(r.id)));
  protected readonly canNext = computed(() => {
    switch (this.step()) {
      case 1:
        return !!this.from() && this.onRecipes() + this.onPrep() > 0;
      case 2:
        return !!this.to() && this.to() !== this.from();
      default:
        return this.ratio() !== null;
    }
  });
  protected readonly canSwap = computed(() => !this.saving() && !this.busy() && this.chosenRecipes().length + this.chosenPrep().length > 0);

  constructor() {
    void this.start();
  }

  ngOnDestroy(): void {
    if (this.refreshTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.refreshTimer);
    }
  }

  protected pickFrom(id: string | null): void {
    this.from.set(id);
    this.usage.set(null);
    if (this.to() === id) {
      this.to.set(null);
    }
    const item = this.materials().find((m) => m.id === id);
    if (item) {
      const each = item.unit === 'Piece' ? 1 : 100;
      this.base.set(each);
      this.replacement.set(each);
      void this.loadUsage(item.id);
    }
  }

  protected resetRatio(): void {
    this.replacement.set(this.base());
  }

  protected priceOf(item: MaterialCost): string {
    const perUnit = recipeCostOf(item);
    return perUnit === null ? 'no price yet' : `${this.company.money(perUnit * item.purchaseUnitSize)} / ${item.purchaseUnit}`;
  }

  protected isChosen(row: SwapPreviewRow): boolean {
    return !row.blocked && this.chosen().has(row.id);
  }

  protected choose(row: SwapPreviewRow, checked: boolean): void {
    const next = new Set(this.chosen());
    if (checked) {
      next.add(row.id);
    } else {
      next.delete(row.id);
    }
    this.chosen.set(next);
    this.refreshSoon();
  }

  protected chooseAll(checked: boolean): void {
    this.chosen.set(new Set(checked ? this.choosable().map((r) => r.id) : []));
    this.refreshSoon();
  }

  // What the quantities are for: a dish's portions, a prep item's batch.
  protected makes(row: SwapPreviewRow): string {
    if (row.kind !== 'PrepItem') {
      return row.portions === 1 ? 'for 1 portion' : `for ${row.portions} portions`;
    }
    const unit = this.materials().find((m) => m.id === row.id)?.unit;
    return `for a batch of ${(row.batchQuantity ?? 0).toLocaleString('en', { maximumFractionDigits: 3 })}${unit ? ' ' + unitShort[unit] : ''}`;
  }

  protected signed(value: number | null): string {
    if (value === null) {
      return '—';
    }
    const money = this.company.money(Math.abs(value));
    return value > 0 ? `+${money}` : value < 0 ? `−${money}` : money;
  }

  protected fc(value: number | null): string {
    return value === null ? '—' : `${value.toFixed(1)}%`;
  }

  protected back(): void {
    this.error.set(null);
    this.step.update((s) => Math.max(1, s - 1));
  }

  protected async next(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canNext()) {
      return;
    }
    this.error.set(null);
    if (this.step() < 3) {
      this.step.update((s) => s + 1);
      return;
    }
    // Every row it can be ticked to start with.
    const preview = await this.run(this.api.previewBulkSwap({ fromMaterialId: this.from()!, toMaterialId: this.to()!, ratio: this.ratio()! }));
    if (preview) {
      this.preview.set(preview);
      this.chosen.set(new Set(preview.rows.filter((r) => r.selected).map((r) => r.id)));
      this.step.set(4);
    }
  }

  protected async swap(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.canSwap()) {
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);
    try {
      const done = await firstValueFrom(this.api.bulkSwap(this.request()));
      this.notify.info(
        `${this.fromItem()?.name} swapped for ${this.toItem()?.name} in ${done.recipes} ${done.recipes === 1 ? 'recipe' : 'recipes'} and ${done.prepItems} ${done.prepItems === 1 ? 'prep item' : 'prep items'}. · تم الاستبدال.`,
      );
      this.ref.close(done);
    } catch (error) {
      this.error.set(errorMessage(error, 'The swap could not be made. Nothing was changed.'));
    } finally {
      this.saving.set(false);
    }
  }

  protected close(): void {
    this.ref.close();
  }

  private request() {
    return {
      fromMaterialId: this.from()!,
      toMaterialId: this.to()!,
      ratio: this.ratio()!,
      recipeIds: this.chosenRecipes(),
      prepItemIds: this.chosenPrep(),
    };
  }

  // The costs again with the rows chosen: a prep item left out moves no dish.
  private refreshSoon(): void {
    if (this.refreshTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.refreshTimer);
    }
    this.refreshTimer = setTimeout(() => void this.refresh(), 300);
  }

  private async refresh(): Promise<void> {
    const sequence = ++this.sequence;
    const preview = await this.run(this.api.previewBulkSwap(this.request()));
    if (preview && sequence === this.sequence) {
      this.preview.set(preview);
    }
  }

  private async run<T>(call: Observable<T>): Promise<T | null> {
    this.busy.set(true);
    try {
      return await firstValueFrom(call);
    } catch (error) {
      this.error.set(errorMessage(error, 'The swap could not be previewed.'));
      return null;
    } finally {
      this.busy.set(false);
    }
  }

  private async start(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.materials.set(await firstValueFrom(this.api.materials()));
    } catch (error) {
      this.error.set(errorMessage(error, 'The items could not be loaded.'));
      return;
    }
    if (this.data?.fromMaterialId) {
      this.pickFrom(this.data.fromMaterialId);
      this.step.set(2);
    }
  }

  private async loadUsage(id: string): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const usage = await firstValueFrom(this.api.whereUsed(id));
      if (this.from() === id) {
        this.usage.set(usage);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.error.set(errorMessage(error, 'Where it is used could not be loaded.'));
    }
  }
}

// The wizard over the page; resolves with what was swapped, or nothing when it was left.
export function showBulkSwap(dialog: MatDialog, fromMaterialId?: string | null): Promise<BulkSwapResult | undefined> {
  return firstValueFrom(
    dialog
      .open<BulkSwapDialog, BulkSwapData, BulkSwapResult | undefined>(BulkSwapDialog, {
        data: { fromMaterialId },
        width: '1100px',
        maxWidth: '96vw',
        autoFocus: 'dialog',
      })
      .afterClosed(),
  );
}
```


**العروض المجمعة:** تبويب في الوصفات. `CombosPage` تعرض كل عرض بأصنافه وتكلفته وسعره منفصلًا ونسبته. و`ComboDialog` يبني العرض من الوصفات الموجودة ويحسب وهو يُكتب نفس معادلات الخادم (التكلفة، السعر منفصلًا والتوفير، نسبة التكلفة مقابل المستهدف)، والكود ثابت بعد الحفظ.

```ts
import { Component, computed, inject, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { MatButtonModule } from '@angular/material/button';

import { MatTooltipModule } from '@angular/material/tooltip';

// Combos & offers (العروض والوجبات المجمعة): dishes the kitchen already makes, sold together at a

// what it costs, what the dishes would sell for apart and its food cost % are worked out from them.
// Sold under its code, on the menu in the Combos & offers category.
@Component({
  selector: 'app-combos-page',
  imports: [DecimalPipe, InfoTip, MatButtonModule, MatIconModule, MatProgressBarModule, MatTooltipModule, MoneyPipe, SearchField],
  template: `
    <div class="toolbar smart">
      <app-search-field [(value)]="search" placeholder="Combo, code or dish · العرض أو الكود أو الصنف" />
      <span class="spacer"></span>
      @if (canManage()) {
        <button mat-flat-button (click)="edit(null)" [disabled]="!report()"><mat-icon>add</mat-icon> New combo · عرض جديد</button>
      }
    </div>
    @if (loading()) {
      <mat-progress-bar mode="indeterminate" />
    }
    @if (error(); as e) {
      <p class="error">{{ e }}</p>
    } @else if (report(); as r) {
      <div class="table-wrap">
        <table class="grid combos">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Code<span class="ar">الكود</span></th>
              <th>Combo<span class="ar">العرض</span></th>
              <th>Dishes<span class="ar">الأصناف</span></th>
              <th class="num">Price<span class="ar">السعر</span></th>
              <th class="num">Total cost <app-info-tip tip="coTotalCost" /><span class="ar">التكلفة</span></th>
              <th class="num">Apart <app-info-tip tip="coOriginal" /><span class="ar">منفصلًا</span></th>
              <th class="num">Food cost % <app-info-tip tip="coFoodCost" /><span class="ar">نسبة التكلفة</span></th>
              <th class="num"><span class="visually-hidden">Actions</span></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (c of shown(); track c.id) {
              <tr [class.off]="!c.isActive">
                <td class="code">{{ c.code }}</td>
                <td>
                  <strong>{{ c.name }}</strong>
                  @if (c.nameAr) {
                    <span class="ar">{{ c.nameAr }}</span>
                  }
                  @if (!c.isActive) {
                    <div class="muted small">Not on sale · غير متاح</div>
                  }
                </td>
                <td class="dishes">{{ dishes(c) }}</td>
                <td class="num">{{ c.sellingPrice | money }}</td>
                <td class="num">{{ c.totalCost | money }}</td>
                <td class="num">
                  {{ c.originalPrice === null ? '—' : (c.originalPrice | money) }}
                  @if (c.savingsPercent !== null) {
                    <div class="muted small">saves {{ c.savingsPercent | number: '1.0-1' }}%</div>
                  }
                </td>
                <td class="num">
                  <span class="status" [class]="c.status">{{ c.foodCostPercent === null ? '—' : (c.foodCostPercent | number: '1.1-1') + '%' }}</span>
                  <div class="muted small">{{ statusLabels[c.status].en }}</div>

export class CombosPage {
  private readonly api = inject(CostingApi);
  private readonly dialog = inject(MatDialog);
  private readonly notify = inject(NotifyService);
  private readonly auth = inject(AuthService);
  protected readonly statusLabels = statusLabels;
  protected readonly report = signal<ComboOffersReport | null>(null);
  private readonly recipes = signal<RecipeCostCard[]>([]);
  protected readonly loading = signal(true);
  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly search = signal('');
  protected readonly canManage = computed(() => this.auth.can(Permissions.InventoryManage));
  protected readonly shown = computed(() =>
    (this.report()?.combos ?? []).filter((c) => smartMatch(this.search(), c.name, c.nameAr, String(c.code), ...c.items.map((i) => i.dish))),
  );

  constructor() {
    void this.load();
  }

  protected dishes(combo: ComboOffer): string {
    return combo.items.map((i) => `${i.quantity}× ${i.dish}`).join(' + ');
  }

  protected async edit(combo: ComboOffer | null): Promise<void> {
    const report = this.report();
    if (!report) {
      return;
    }
    const saved = await showComboDialog(this.dialog, {
      combo, nextCode: report.nextCode, foodCostTargetPercent: report.foodCostTargetPercent, recipes: this.recipes(),
    });
    if (saved) {
      await this.load();
    }
  }

  protected async remove(combo: ComboOffer): Promise<void> {
    if (!confirm(`Delete ${combo.name}? It leaves the menu; its sales keep it. · حذف العرض؟`)) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      await firstValueFrom(this.api.deleteCombo(combo.id));
      this.notify.info(`${combo.name} deleted. · تم حذف العرض.`);
      await this.load();
    } catch (error) {
      this.notify.error(error, 'The combo could not be deleted.');
    }
  }

  private async load(): Promise<void> {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);
    try {
      const [report, recipes] = await Promise.all([firstValueFrom(this.api.combos()), firstValueFrom(this.api.recipes())]);
      this.report.set(report);
      this.recipes.set(recipes);
    } catch (error) {
      this.error.set(errorMessage(error, 'The combos could not be loaded.'));
    } finally {
      this.loading.set(false);
    }
  }
}
```

```ts
})
export class ComboDialog {
  protected readonly data = inject<ComboDialogData>(MAT_DIALOG_DATA);
  protected readonly ref = inject(MatDialogRef<ComboDialog, boolean>);
  private readonly api = inject(CostingApi);
  private readonly company = inject(Company);
  private readonly notify = inject(NotifyService);

  protected readonly code = signal<number | null>(this.data.combo?.code ?? this.data.nextCode);
  protected readonly name = signal(this.data.combo?.name ?? '');
  protected readonly nameAr = signal(this.data.combo?.nameAr ?? '');
  protected readonly price = signal<number | null>(this.data.combo?.sellingPrice ?? null);
  protected readonly active = signal(this.data.combo?.isActive ?? true);
  protected readonly lines = signal<Line[]>(
    this.data.combo?.items.map((i) => ({ recipeId: i.recipeId, quantity: i.quantity })) ?? [{ recipeId: null, quantity: 1 }, { recipeId: null, quantity: 1 }],
  );
  protected readonly saving = signal(false);
  protected readonly problem = signal<string | null>(null);

  private readonly byId = computed(() => new Map(this.data.recipes.filter((r) => r.recipeId).map((r) => [r.recipeId!, r])));
  protected readonly pickItems = computed<PickItem[]>(() =>
    this.data.recipes
      .filter((r) => r.recipeId && !r.isDeleted)
      .map((r) => ({
        id: r.recipeId!, name: r.recipe, code: r.itemCode || null, kind: 'menu' as const, unit: 'portion', detail: r.category,
        cost: `${this.company.money(r.costPerPortion)} a portion`,
      }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)),
  );

  // Worked out as the screen is filled in, as the server will: Σ cost × quantity, Σ price × quantity.
  protected readonly totals = computed(() => {
    const chosen = this.lines()
      .map((l) => ({ card: l.recipeId ? this.byId().get(l.recipeId) : undefined, quantity: Number(l.quantity) || 0 }))
      .filter((l) => l.card && l.quantity > 0);
    const cost = round(chosen.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.card!.costPerPortion * l.quantity, 0));
    const original = chosen.length > 0 && chosen.every((l) => l.card!.menuPrice !== null)
      ? round(chosen.reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.card!.menuPrice! * l.quantity, 0))
      : null;
    const price = Number(this.price()) || 0;
    const savings = original !== null && price > 0 ? round(original - price) : null;
    return {
      cost,
      original,
      savings,
      savingsPercent: savings !== null && original! > 0 ? (savings / original!) * 100 : null,
      foodCost: price > 0 && chosen.length > 0 ? Math.round((cost / price) * 1000) / 10 : null,
    };
  });

  protected cardOf(line: Line): RecipeCostCard | null {
    return (line.recipeId && this.byId().get(line.recipeId)) || null;
  }

  protected change(index: number, patch: Partial<Line>): void {
    this.lines.update((lines) => lines.map((l, i) => (i === index ? { ...l, ...patch } : l)));
  }

  protected add(): void {
    this.lines.update((lines) => [...lines, { recipeId: null, quantity: 1 }]);
  }

  protected remove(index: number): void {
    this.lines.update((lines) => lines.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  }

  protected async save(): Promise<void> {
    const items = this.lines().filter((l) => l.recipeId).map((l) => ({ recipeId: l.recipeId!, quantity: Number(l.quantity) }));
    const code = Number(this.code());
    const price = Number(this.price());
    if (!this.name().trim()) {
      this.problem.set('Name the combo. · اكتب اسم العرض.');
      return;
    }
    if (!Number.isInteger(code) || code < 1) {
      this.problem.set('The code is a menu number, 1 or more. · الكود رقم 1 أو أكثر.');
      return;
    }
    if (!(price > 0)) {
      this.problem.set('Set the combo\'s price. · حدد سعر العرض.');
      return;
    }
    if (items.length === 0 || items.some((i) => !Number.isInteger(i.quantity) || i.quantity < 1 || i.quantity > 99)) {
      this.problem.set('Choose each dish and how many of it, 1 to 99. · اختر الأصناف وعددها.');
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.problem.set(null);
    try {
      await firstValueFrom(
        this.api.saveCombo(this.data.combo?.id ?? crypto.randomUUID(), {
          code, name: this.name().trim(), nameAr: this.nameAr().trim() || null, sellingPrice: price, isActive: this.active(), items,
        }),
      );
      this.notify.info(`${this.name().trim()} saved. · تم حفظ العرض.`);
      this.ref.close(true);
    } catch (error) {
      this.problem.set(errorMessage(error, 'The combo could not be saved.'));
    } finally {
      this.saving.set(false);
    }
  }
}

function round(value: number): number {
  return Math.round(value * 100) / 100;
}

export function showComboDialog(dialog: MatDialog, data: ComboDialogData): Promise<boolean | undefined> {
  return firstValueFrom(
    dialog.open<ComboDialog, ComboDialogData, boolean>(ComboDialog, { data, width: '980px', maxWidth: '96vw', autoFocus: 'dialog' }).afterClosed(),
  );
}
```

### 7.1 بطاقة الوصفة (`RecipeCardPage`): الشاشة الأهم محاسبيًا

لكل سطر، كما في القالب الورقي: `EP$/وحدة = AP$/وحدة ÷ Yield`، وتكلفة السطر = كمية EP × EP$ (بوحدات الشراء). ثم تكلفة الحصة، سعر البيع، نسبة التكلفة، والحالة مقابل الهدف. المصنّع بلا دفعات يظهر "حسب وصفته". الربط بصنف/حجم/إضافة من المنيو، والأسطر بـ `GridKeys`.

```ts
import { Approvals } from './approvals';
import { RecipeCategoryDialog, RecipeCategoryDialogData } from './recipe-category-dialog';
import { GridKeys } from '../shared/grid-keys';
import { MaterialPicker } from './material-picker';
import { InfoTip } from './info-tip';

interface Line {
  rawMaterialId: string | null;
  quantity: number | null;
  yieldPercent: number | null;
}

// What one line works out to, as the template does it: EP$/unit = AP$/unit ÷ yield, and the
// line's cost is EP quantity × EP$, in purchase units.
interface Costed {
  material: MaterialCost | undefined;
  aps: number | null;
  eps: number | null;
  cost: number | null;
  // A prep item never made yet, costed by its own recipe today.
  byRecipe: boolean;
}

// A menu item a recipe can be linked to, as the link list offers it.
interface LinkOption {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  card: RecipeCostCard;
  // Already sells by another recipe.
  taken: boolean;
}

// view: the card, read-only. edit and new: the recipe written. menu: an old link to a menu item's
// card (/costing/recipes/MenuItem/6), sent on to its recipe, or to a new one for it.
export type RecipeCardMode = 'view' | 'edit' | 'new' | 'menu';

// Rounded as the server rounds (to the cent or the tenth, halves away from zero). The figure is
// first cut to 15 significant digits, so 228.94 / 4, stored as 57.23499…, rounds to 57.24.
const roundTo = (value: number, places: number) => {
  const scaled = Number((Math.abs(value) * 10 ** places).toPrecision(15));
  return (Math.sign(value) * Math.round(scaled)) / 10 ** places;
};
const round = (value: number) => roundTo(value, 2);

const linkKey = (kind: RecipeTargetKind | null, catalogItemId: number | null, variantId: number | null) =>
  kind && catalogItemId !== null ? `${kind}|${catalogItemId}|${variantId ?? ''}` : null;

// The Recipe Costing Template for one recipe. The recipe is written as the kitchen makes it: the
// edible portion (EP) of each ingredient for the whole batch, and how many portions the batch
// gives. Linked to a menu item, that item sells by it; off the menu (R&D), it is costed against
// a planned price, never sold. Figures follow every change.
@Component({
  selector: 'app-recipe-card-page',
  imports: [
    DatePipe,
    DecimalPipe,
    FormsModule,
    InfoTip,
    GridKeys,
    MatButtonModule,
    MatFormFieldModule,
    MatIconModule,
    MatInputModule,
    MaterialPicker,
    MatProgressBarModule,
    MatSelectModule,
    MoneyPipe,
    RouterLink,
  ],
  template: `
    <div class="toolbar no-print">
      <a mat-button routerLink="/costing/recipes"><mat-icon>arrow_back</mat-icon> All recipes</a>
      <span class="spacer"></span>
      @if (mode() === 'view' && card(); as c) {
        @if (!c.isDeleted && canEdit() && !pending()) {
          <a mat-button [routerLink]="['/costing/recipes/recipe', c.recipeId, 'edit']"><mat-icon>edit</mat-icon> Edit</a>
          <button mat-button class="danger-text" (click)="removeRecipe()" [disabled]="saving()"><mat-icon>delete</mat-icon> Delete</button>
        }
        <button mat-button (click)="print()"><mat-icon>print</mat-icon> Print</button>
      }
    </div>
    @if (loading()) {
      <mat-progress-bar mode="indeterminate" />
    } @else if (error()) {
      <p class="error">{{ error() }}</p>
    } @else {
      <section class="sheet">
        @if (card()?.isDeleted) {
          <div class="banner no-print">
            <span>
              Deleted {{ card()!.deletedAtUtc | date: 'd MMM y, HH:mm' }}{{ card()!.deletedBy ? ' by ' + card()!.deletedBy : '' }}.
              Kept for the record; no sale takes stock by it.
            </span>
            <span class="spacer"></span>
            @if (canEdit()) {
              <button mat-flat-button (click)="restore()" [disabled]="saving()"><mat-icon>restore_from_trash</mat-icon> Restore</button>
            }
          </div>
        }
        @if (pending(); as p) {
          <div class="banner pending no-print">
            <mat-icon>lock_clock</mat-icon>
            <span>
              {{ p.requestedBy }} asked to delete this recipe on {{ p.requestedAtUtc | date: 'd MMM y, HH:mm' }}. It stays as it is, and
              cannot be changed, until a manager decides.
            </span>
          </div>
        }

        <header class="title">
          <div>
            <h2>{{ title() }}</h2>
            @if (card()?.recipeAr && !editing()) {
              <div class="ar title-ar">{{ card()!.recipeAr }}</div>
            }
            <div class="muted subtitle">
              @if (linkedName(); as menuItem) {
                <span class="link linked">Linked to menu: {{ menuItem }}<span class="ar">مرتبطة بالمنيو</span></span>
              } @else {
                <span class="link standalone">Standalone / Off-menu<span class="ar">وصفة مستقلة</span></span>
              }
              @if (card()?.itemCode && !editing()) {
                · Item code<span class="inline-ar">كود الصنف</span>: <strong>{{ card()!.itemCode }}</strong>
              }
              @if (!editing()) {
                · <span class="category" [class.unsorted]="!card()?.recipeCategory">{{ card()?.recipeCategory ?? 'Uncategorized' }}</span>
                @if (card()?.recipeCategoryAr) {
                  <span class="inline-ar">{{ card()!.recipeCategoryAr }}</span>
                }
              }
              @if (!editing() && card()?.recipeId && !card()!.usesBaseRecipe) {
                · <span class="station-pick">
                  Station<span class="inline-ar">القسم</span> <app-info-tip tip="kitchenStation" />:
                  @if (canEdit() && !card()!.isDeleted) {
                    <mat-select class="station-select no-print" [value]="card()!.kitchenStationId ?? ''" (selectionChange)="setStation($event.value || null)"
                      aria-label="Station that makes it" panelWidth="auto">
                      <mat-option value="">None (its materials' own)</mat-option>
                      @for (s of stations.active(); track s.id) {
                        <mat-option [value]="s.id">{{ s.name }}{{ s.nameAr ? ' · ' + s.nameAr : '' }}</mat-option>
                      }
                    </mat-select>
                  } @else {
                    <strong>{{ card()!.kitchenStationId ? stations.label(card()!.kitchenStationId) : 'None' }}</strong>
                  }
                </span>
              }
            </div>
          </div>
          <span class="status" [class]="status()">
            {{ statusLabels[status()].en }}<span class="ar">{{ statusLabels[status()].ar }}</span>
          </span>
        </header>

        @if (editing()) {
          <div class="form no-print">
            <mat-form-field>
              <mat-label>Recipe name · اسم الوصفة</mat-label>
              <input matInput [ngModel]="name()" (ngModelChange)="name.set($event)" maxlength="200" [placeholder]="linked()?.label ?? ''" aria-label="Recipe name" />
              @if (linked()) {
                <mat-hint>Blank: it goes by the menu item's name.</mat-hint>
              }
            </mat-form-field>
            <mat-form-field>
              <mat-label>Recipe category · قسم الوصفة</mat-label>
              <mat-select #categorySelect [ngModel]="categoryId()" (ngModelChange)="categoryChosen($event, categorySelect)" aria-label="Recipe category" required>
                @for (c of categories(); track c.id) {
                  <mat-option [value]="c.id">{{ c.name }}{{ c.nameAr ? ' · ' + c.nameAr : '' }}</mat-option>
                }
                <mat-option [value]="newCategory" class="add-new">+ New category…</mat-option>
              </mat-select>
              @if (!categoryId()) {
                <mat-hint>Required: the kitchen's own sorting, not the menu's.</mat-hint>
              }
            </mat-form-field>
            <mat-form-field class="wide">
              <mat-label>Link to POS menu item · الربط بصنف المنيو</mat-label>
              <mat-select [ngModel]="link()" (ngModelChange)="link.set($event)" aria-label="Link to POS menu item">
                <mat-option [value]="null">None: off the menu (R&amp;D) · بدون ربط</mat-option>
                @for (o of linkOptions(); track o.key) {
                  <mat-option [value]="o.key" [disabled]="o.taken">{{ o.label }}{{ o.taken ? ' · has a recipe' : '' }}</mat-option>
                }
              </mat-select>
              <mat-hint>{{ linked() ? 'Sales of it take stock by this recipe.' : 'Costed only: no sale takes stock by it.' }}</mat-hint>
            </mat-form-field>
            @if (!linked()) {
              <mat-form-field>
                <mat-label>Planned price, {{ company.currency() }} · السعر المخطط</mat-label>
                <input matInput type="number" min="0" step="any" [ngModel]="plannedPrice()" (ngModelChange)="plannedPrice.set($event)" aria-label="Planned price" />
                <mat-hint>Optional, before VAT: for its food cost %.</mat-hint>
              </mat-form-field>
            }
          </div>
        }

        <div class="figures">
          <div class="box key">
            <span class="label">Cost per recipe <app-info-tip tip="costPerRecipe" /><span class="ar">تكلفة الوصفة</span></span>
            <strong>{{ costPerRecipe() | money }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="box key">
            <span class="label">Cost per portion <app-info-tip tip="costPerPortion" /><span class="ar">تكلفة الحصة</span></span>
            <strong>{{ costPerPortion() | money }}</strong>
            @if (shared() > 0) {
              <small class="chip">+{{ shared() | money }} shared</small>
            }
          </div>
          <div class="box key">
            <span class="label">Margin per portion <app-info-tip tip="marginPerPortion" /><span class="ar">هامش الحصة</span></span>
            <strong>{{ price() === null || lines().length === 0 ? '—' : (margin() | money) }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="box">
            <span class="label">Portions <app-info-tip tip="portions" /><span class="ar">عدد الحصص</span></span>
            @if (editing()) {
              <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="portions">
                <input matInput type="number" min="1" step="1" [ngModel]="portions()" (ngModelChange)="portions.set($event)" aria-label="Portions" />
              </mat-form-field>
            } @else {
              <strong>{{ portions() }}</strong>
            }
          </div>
          <div class="box">
            <span class="label">Prep time (mins) <app-info-tip tip="bcPrepTime" /><span class="ar">وقت التحضير بالدقائق</span></span>
            @if (editing()) {
              <div class="prep">
                <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="minutes">
                  <input matInput type="number" min="0" max="1440" step="any" placeholder="10" [ngModel]="prepTime()"
                    (ngModelChange)="prepTime.set(figure($event))" aria-label="Prep time in minutes for one plate" />
                </mat-form-field>
                <span class="times" aria-hidden="true">×</span>
                <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="weight">
                  <input matInput type="number" min="0.1" max="10" step="0.1" [ngModel]="complexity()"
                    (ngModelChange)="complexity.set(figure($event))" aria-label="Complexity weight" />
                </mat-form-field>
              </div>
              <small class="muted">One plate; × complexity (1 ordinary) · للطبق × معامل الصعوبة</small>
            } @else {
              <strong>{{ prepTime() === null ? '10' : (prepTime() | number: '1.0-2') }} min</strong>
              <small class="muted">{{ prepTime() === null ? 'Default · افتراضي' : '' }}{{ complexity() !== 1 ? ' × ' + complexity() + ' complexity' : '' }}</small>
            }
          </div>
          <div class="box">
            <span class="label">{{ linked() ? 'Menu price' : 'Planned price' }} <app-info-tip tip="sellingPrice" /><span class="ar">{{ linked() ? 'سعر البيع' : 'السعر المخطط' }}</span></span>
            <strong>{{ price() === null ? '—' : (price() | money) }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="box">
            <span class="label">Food cost % budget <app-info-tip tip="foodCostBudget" /><span class="ar">نسبة التكلفة المستهدفة</span></span>
            <strong>{{ target() | number: '1.0-1' }}%</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="box" [class.over]="status() === 'AboveTarget'">
            <span class="label">Food cost % actual <app-info-tip tip="foodCostPercent" /><span class="ar">نسبة التكلفة الفعلية</span></span>
            <strong>{{ foodCost() === null ? '—' : (foodCost() | number: '1.1-1') + '%' }}</strong>
          </div>
          <div class="box">
            <span class="label">Ideal selling price <app-info-tip tip="idealPrice" /><span class="ar">سعر البيع المثالي</span></span>
            <strong>{{ lines().length ? (idealPrice() | money) : '—' }}</strong>
          </div>
        </div>

        @if (burdened(); as b) {
          @if (b.plate; as p) {
            <section class="burdened" aria-label="Fully burdened cost breakdown">
              <h3>
                Fully burdened cost breakdown <span class="inline-ar">التكلفة الكلية شاملة التشغيل</span>
                <app-info-tip tip="bcBurdened" />
              </h3>
              @if (p.fullyBurdenedCost !== null && p.directFoodCost !== null) {
                <p class="equation">
                  <span class="term food"><strong>{{ p.directFoodCost | money }}</strong> الخامات · food</span>
                  <span class="op">+</span>
                  <span class="term labor"><strong>{{ p.allocatedLaborCost | money }}</strong> العمالة · labor</span>
                  <span class="op">+</span>
                  <span class="term overhead"><strong>{{ p.allocatedOverheadCost | money }}</strong> الإيجار والمرافق · overhead</span>
                  <span class="op">=</span>
                  <span class="term total"><strong>{{ p.fullyBurdenedCost | money }}</strong> التكلفة الكلية · fully burdened</span>
                  @if (p.trueNetProfitPerPlate !== null) {
                    <span class="net" [class.loss]="p.trueNetProfitPerPlate < 0">
                      (صافي الربح · net profit: {{ p.trueNetProfitPerPlate | money }} · {{ p.trueNetMarginPercent | number: '1.1-1' }}%)
                    </span>
                  }
                </p>
              } @else {
                <p class="muted">
                  {{ p.status === 'NotAllocated'
                    ? 'No plates sold this month yet: nothing to share the labor and overheads over. · لا مبيعات هذا الشهر بعد.'
                    : 'Give it a price to see its true net profit. · حدد السعر.' }}
                </p>
              }
              <p class="muted basis">
                {{ methodLabels[b.method].en }} · {{ methodLabels[b.method].ar }}, this month so far ({{ b.platesSold | number: '1.0-0' }} plates sold),
                {{ p.weightedMinutes | number: '1.0-2' }} weighted min a plate{{ p.estimated ? '; not sold yet: estimated' : '' }}.
                @if (p.suggestedPriceForTargetNetMargin !== null) {
                  {{ b.targetNetMarginPercent | number: '1.0-1' }}% net margin at {{ p.suggestedPriceForTargetNetMargin | money }}.
                }
                @if (dirty()) {
                  <strong>As last saved · حسب آخر حفظ.</strong>
                }
                @if (canSeeBurdened) {
                  <a routerLink="/costing/intelligence/burdened">Every dish · كل الأطباق</a>
                }
              </p>
            </section>
          }
        }

        <div class="table-wrap">
          <table class="grid" appGridKeys (appGridKeysAppend)="add()">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th>Ingredients<span class="ar">المكونات</span></th>
                <th class="num">Recipe quantity (EP)<span class="ar">كمية الوصفة (صافي)</span></th>
                <th class="num">AP$ / unit <app-info-tip tip="apUnit" /><span class="ar">تكلفة الشراء</span></th>
                <th>Unit<span class="ar">الوحدة</span></th>
                <th class="num">Yield % <app-info-tip tip="yieldPercent" /><span class="ar">نسبة الصافي</span></th>
                <th class="num">EP$ / unit <app-info-tip tip="epUnit" /><span class="ar">تكلفة الصافي</span></th>
                <th class="num">Recipe cost<span class="ar">تكلفة المكون</span></th>
                @if (editing()) {
                  <th class="no-print"></th>
                }
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              @for (line of lines(); track $index; let i = $index) {
                @let x = costed()[i];
                <tr>
                  <td>
                    @if (editing()) {
                      <app-material-picker class="ingredient" [materials]="materials()" [value]="line.rawMaterialId" (valueChange)="choose(i, $event!)"
                        [label]="'Ingredient, line ' + (i + 1)" />
                    } @else {
                      {{ x.material?.name }}
                    }
                  </td>
                  <td class="num">
                    @if (editing()) {
                      <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="small">
                        <input matInput type="number" min="0" step="any" [ngModel]="line.quantity" (ngModelChange)="change(i, { quantity: $event })" [attr.aria-label]="'Quantity, line ' + (i + 1)" />
                        <span matTextSuffix>&nbsp;{{ x.material ? unit(x.material) : '' }}</span>
                      </mat-form-field>
                    } @else {
                      {{ line.quantity | number: '1.0-3' }} {{ x.material ? unit(x.material) : '' }}
                    }
                  </td>
                  <td class="num">
                    @if (x.aps !== null) {
                      {{ x.aps | money }}
                      @if (x.byRecipe) {
                        <div class="by-recipe" title="Not made yet: costed by its own recipe today, until a batch is made">By its recipe · حسب وصفته</div>
                      }
                    } @else if (x.material) {
                      <span class="error">No price</span>
                    }
                  </td>
                  <td>{{ x.material?.purchaseUnit ?? '' }}</td>
                  <td class="num">
                    @if (editing()) {
                      <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="yield">
                        <input matInput type="number" min="1" max="100" step="any" [ngModel]="line.yieldPercent" (ngModelChange)="change(i, { yieldPercent: $event })" [attr.aria-label]="'Yield, line ' + (i + 1)" />
                        <span matTextSuffix>%</span>
                      </mat-form-field>
                    } @else {
                      {{ line.yieldPercent | number: '1.0-2' }}%
                    }
                  </td>
                  <td class="num">{{ x.eps === null ? '' : (x.eps | money) }}</td>
                  <td class="num">{{ x.cost === null ? '' : (x.cost | money) }}</td>
                  @if (editing()) {
                    <td class="no-print">
                      <button mat-icon-button (click)="remove(i)" aria-label="Remove ingredient"><mat-icon>delete</mat-icon></button>
                    </td>
                  }
                </tr>
              } @empty {
                <tr><td [attr.colspan]="editing() ? 8 : 7" class="muted">No ingredients yet.</td></tr>
              }
            </tbody>
            <tfoot>
              <tr>
                <td>
                  @if (editing()) {
                    <button mat-button class="no-print" (click)="add()" [disabled]="materials().length === 0"><mat-icon>add</mat-icon> Add ingredient</button>
                  }
                </td>
                <td colspan="5" class="num">Total · الإجمالي</td>
                <td class="num">{{ costPerRecipe() | money }}</td>
                @if (editing()) {
                  <td class="no-print"></td>
                }
              </tr>
            </tfoot>
          </table>
        </div>

        @if (editing() && materials().length === 0) {
          <p class="note">Add the raw materials first, on the Raw materials tab, with their prices.</p>
        }
        @if (duplicate()) {
          <p class="error">An ingredient is on two lines: keep one, with the quantities added together.</p>
        }
        @if (missing().length) {
          <p class="error">No price yet for {{ missing().join(', ') }}: the cost shown is short of the truth until they have one.</p>
        }
        @if (byRecipe().length) {
          <p class="note by-recipe-note">
            {{ byRecipe().join(', ') }} {{ byRecipe().length === 1 ? 'is' : 'are' }} not made yet, so costed by {{ byRecipe().length === 1 ? 'its' : 'their' }} own
            recipe today; once a batch is made, at what the batches cost.
            <span class="inline-ar">أصناف مُصنَّعة لم تُصنع بعد: تُحسب تكلفتها من وصفتها اليوم حتى تُصنع أول تشغيلة.</span>
          </p>
        }

        @if (editing()) {
          <div class="toolbar actions no-print">
            <span class="spacer"></span>
            <a mat-button [routerLink]="mode() === 'edit' ? ['/costing/recipes/recipe', recipeId()] : ['/costing/recipes']">Cancel</a>
            <button mat-flat-button (click)="save()" [disabled]="!valid() || (mode() === 'edit' && !dirty()) || saving()">
              <mat-icon>save</mat-icon> {{ mode() === 'new' ? 'Create recipe' : 'Save recipe' }}
            </button>
          </div>
          @if (problem(); as p) {
            <p class="error">{{ p }}</p>
          }
        }
      </section>
    }
  `,
  styleUrl: './costing.scss',
  styles: `
    .station-select {
      display: inline-block;
      width: 170px;
      font-size: 13px;
    }
    .by-recipe {
      font-size: 0.78em;
      color: var(--mat-sys-tertiary);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .sheet {
      display: grid;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .title {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;

      h2 {
        margin: 0;
        font: var(--mat-sys-headline-small);
      }
      .title-ar {
        font-size: 1.1em;
        text-align: start;
      }
    }
    .subtitle {
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .link {
      display: inline-block;
      padding: 2px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font: var(--mat-sys-label-medium);

      .ar {
        display: inline;
        margin-left: 6px;
      }
    }
    .category {
      font-weight: 500;

      &.unsorted {
        color: var(--mat-sys-error);
      }
    }
    .add-new {
      color: var(--mat-sys-primary);
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .linked {
      background: var(--mat-sys-primary-container);
      color: var(--mat-sys-on-primary-container);
    }
    .standalone {
      background: var(--mat-sys-tertiary-container);
      color: var(--mat-sys-on-tertiary-container);
    }
    .form {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      gap: 4px 12px;
    }
    .wide {
      grid-column: span 2;
    }
    .banner {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--mat-sys-surface-container-high);

      &.pending {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-warn) 16%, var(--mat-sys-surface));
        color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface);

        mat-icon {
          color: var(--app-warn);
        }
      }
    }
    .figures {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(170px, 1fr));
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .prep {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      .minutes {
        width: 76px;
      }
      .weight {
        width: 64px;
      }
    }
    .burdened {
      margin: 12px 0;
      padding: 12px 14px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid var(--mat-sys-outline-variant);
      background: var(--mat-sys-surface-container-lowest);

      h3 {
        margin: 0 0 6px;
        font: var(--mat-sys-title-small);
      }
      .equation {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: 6px 8px;
        margin: 0 0 6px;
      }
      .term {
        padding-inline-start: 8px;
        border-inline-start: 4px solid;
      }
      .term.food {
        border-color: #2563eb;
      }
      .term.labor {
        border-color: #d97706;
      }
      .term.overhead {
        border-color: #7c3aed;
      }
      .term.total {
        border-color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface);
      }
      .op {
        color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant);
      }
      .net {
```
