export class EodPayoutForm {
  private readonly api = inject(EndOfDayApi);
  private readonly hrStaff = inject(HrStaffApi);
  protected readonly company = inject(Company);

  readonly date = input.required<string>();
  readonly kind = input.required<EndOfDayPayoutKind>();
  readonly suppliers = input<readonly PickItem[]>([]);
  readonly employees = input<Employee[]>([]);
  // The staff come from HR: chosen from HR's, none added here.
  readonly hrLinked = input(false);
  // Someone added to the staff from here, while HR is not linked.
  readonly staffAdded = output<Employee>();
  // The payment being changed; none for a new one.
  readonly payout = input<EndOfDayPayout | null>(null);
  readonly saved = output<EndOfDay>();
  readonly cancelled = output<void>();
  // Something typed or chosen on a new one, not added yet.
  readonly pendingChange = output<boolean>();

  protected readonly file = signal<File | null>(null);
  protected readonly payeeId = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected amount: number | null = null;
  protected note = '';
  protected readonly saving = signal(false);
  protected readonly problem = signal<string | null>(null);
  private readonly version = signal(0);
  private id = crypto.randomUUID();

  protected readonly labels = computed(() => payoutFormLabels[this.kind()]);
  protected readonly label = computed(() => (this.payout() ? 'Payment' : `New ${this.labels().label}`));
  // Who can be advanced now: those still on the staff, and the one already chosen.
  protected readonly activeEmployees = computed(() =>
    [...this.employees(), ...this.added().filter((a) => !this.employees().some((e) => e.id === a.id))].filter(
      (e) => e.isActive || e.id === this.payout()?.employeeId,
    ),
  );
  protected readonly adding = signal(false);
  protected newName = '';
  private readonly added = signal<Employee[]>([]);

  // The receipt chosen here, else the one handed in.
  protected readonly source = computed<PhotoSource | null>(() => {
    const [file, payout, date] = [this.file(), this.payout(), this.date()];
    return file ?? (payout ? () => this.api.photo(date, payout.id) : null);
  });
  protected readonly fileName = computed(() => this.file()?.name ?? this.payout()?.receipt.fileName ?? '');

  protected readonly dirty = computed(() => {
    this.version();
    return !!this.file() || !!this.payeeId() || !!this.amount || !!this.note.trim();
  });

  // Filled from the payment being changed, once: the day saved again elsewhere leaves what is typed.
  private readonly payoutId = computed(() => this.payout()?.id ?? null);

  constructor() {
    effect(() => {
      this.payoutId();
      untracked(() => {
        const payout = this.payout();
        this.payeeId.set(payout ? (payout.supplierId ?? payout.employeeId) : null);
        this.amount = payout?.amount ?? null;
        this.note = payout?.note ?? '';
        this.file.set(null);
        this.touch();
      });
    });
    effect(() => {
      const dirty = this.dirty();
      if (!this.payout()) {
        untracked(() => this.pendingChange.emit(dirty));
      }
    });
  }

  protected touch(): void {
    this.version.update((v) => v + 1);
    this.problem.set(null);
  }

  // The camera's photo or the file chosen: lighter to send when it is a big photo.
  protected async pick(input: HTMLInputElement): Promise<void> {
    const chosen = input.files?.[0];
    input.value = '';
    if (!chosen) {
      return;
    }
    const file = await shrinkPhoto(chosen);
    const problem = photoProblem(file);
    if (problem) {
      this.problem.set(problem);
      return;
    }
    this.file.set(file);
    this.touch();
  }

  // Someone not on the staff yet, added by name and chosen; the same name again is the one there is.
  protected async addStaff(): Promise<void> {
    const name = this.newName.trim();
    if (!name) {
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.problem.set(null);
    try {
      const made = await firstValueFrom(this.hrStaff.addLocal(crypto.randomUUID(), name, null));
      this.added.update((all) => [...all.filter((e) => e.id !== made.id), made]);
      this.payeeId.set(made.id);
      this.staffAdded.emit(made);
      this.newName = '';
      this.adding.set(false);
      this.touch();
    } catch (error) {
      this.problem.set(errorMessage(error, 'They could not be added to the staff. · تعذر إضافة الموظف.'));
    } finally {
      this.saving.set(false);
    }
  }

  protected clear(): void {
    this.file.set(null);
    this.payeeId.set(null);
    this.amount = null;
    this.note = '';
    this.touch();
  }

  protected async save(): Promise<void> {
    const payout = this.payout();
    const amount = Number(this.amount);
    const labels = this.labels();
    const problem = !this.file() && !payout ? labels.noReceipt : !this.payeeId() ? labels.noPayee : !(amount > 0) ? labels.noAmount : null;
    if (problem) {
      this.problem.set(problem);
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.problem.set(null);
    const entry = { payeeId: this.payeeId()!, amount: round(amount), note: this.note.trim() || null };
    try {
      let day: EndOfDay;
      if (!payout) {
        day = await firstValueFrom(this.api.addPayout(this.date(), this.kind(), this.id, entry, this.file()!));
        this.id = crypto.randomUUID();
        this.clear();
      } else {
        day = await firstValueFrom(this.api.changePayout(this.date(), this.kind(), payout.id, entry));
        const file = this.file();
        if (file) {
          day = await firstValueFrom(this.api.replacePayoutReceipt(this.date(), this.kind(), payout.id, file));
        }
      }
      this.saved.emit(day);
    } catch (error) {
      this.problem.set(errorMessage(error, 'The payment could not be saved. · تعذر حفظ المبلغ.'));
    } finally {
      this.saving.set(false);
    }
  }
}

export class PhotoViewer {
  private readonly sanitizer = inject(DomSanitizer);
  private readonly dialog = inject(MatDialog);

  readonly source = input.required<PhotoSource>();
  readonly fileName = input.required<string>();
  // Offers to open it full size over the page; not from there.
  readonly large = input(true);

  protected readonly steps = zoomSteps;
  protected readonly zoom = signal(1);
  protected readonly image = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly document = signal<SafeResourceUrl | null>(null);
  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly blob = signal<Blob | null>(null);
  protected readonly dragging = signal(false);
  private readonly stage = viewChild<ElementRef<HTMLElement>>('stage');
  private readonly urls: string[] = [];
  private turns = 0;
  private from: { x: number; y: number; left: number; top: number } | null = null;

  constructor() {
    effect(() => {
      const source = this.source();
      untracked(() => void this.load(source));
    });
    inject(DestroyRef).onDestroy(() => this.release());
  }

  protected zoomBy(step: number): void {
    const at = zoomSteps.indexOf(this.zoom());
    this.zoom.set(zoomSteps[Math.min(zoomSteps.length - 1, Math.max(0, (at < 0 ? 2 : at) + step))]);
  }

  // A quarter turn clockwise, drawn again upright: the page around it lays it out as it now is.
  protected async turn(): Promise<void> {
    const blob = this.blob();
    if (!blob) {
      return;
    }
    this.turns = (this.turns + 1) % 4;
    try {
      this.image.set(this.turns === 0 ? this.urls[0] : await this.turned(blob, this.turns));
    } catch {
      // A browser that cannot draw it: left as it was.
    }
  }

  protected openLarge(): void {
    this.dialog.open<PhotoDialog, PhotoDialogData>(PhotoDialog, {
      data: { source: this.source(), fileName: this.fileName() },
      width: '96vw',
      maxWidth: '1200px',
    });
  }

  protected download(): void {
    const blob = this.blob();
    if (blob) {
      saveBlob(blob, this.fileName());
    }
  }

  // Dragged about with a finger or the mouse, when it is bigger than where it is shown.
  protected grab(event: PointerEvent): void {
    const stage = this.stage()?.nativeElement;
    if (!stage || event.button !== 0 || event.pointerType === 'touch') {
      return;
    }
    this.from = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY, left: stage.scrollLeft, top: stage.scrollTop };
    stage.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId);
    this.dragging.set(true);
  }

  protected drag(event: PointerEvent): void {
    const stage = this.stage()?.nativeElement;
    if (!stage || !this.from) {
      return;
    }
    stage.scrollLeft = this.from.left - (event.clientX - this.from.x);
    stage.scrollTop = this.from.top - (event.clientY - this.from.y);
  }

  protected drop(event: PointerEvent): void {
    if (!this.from) {
      return;
    }
    this.from = null;
    this.dragging.set(false);
    const stage = this.stage()?.nativeElement;
    if (stage?.hasPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId)) {
      stage.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    }
  }

  private async load(source: PhotoSource): Promise<void> {
    this.release();
    this.image.set(null);
    this.document.set(null);
    this.error.set(null);
    this.zoom.set(1);
    this.turns = 0;
    try {
      const blob = await blobOf(source);
      this.blob.set(blob);
      const url = this.keep(URL.createObjectURL(blob));
      if (blob.type.startsWith('image/')) {
        this.image.set(url);
      } else {
        // A PDF, checked by its first bytes when it was handed in, in the browser's own viewer.
        this.document.set(this.sanitizer.bypassSecurityTrustResourceUrl(url));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.error.set(errorMessage(error, 'The photo could not be loaded. · تعذر تحميل الصورة.'));
    }
  }

  private async turned(blob: Blob, turns: number): Promise<string> {
    const bitmap = await createImageBitmap(blob);
    const sideways = turns % 2 === 1;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = sideways ? bitmap.height : bitmap.width;
    canvas.height = sideways ? bitmap.width : bitmap.height;
    const context = canvas.getContext('2d')!;
    context.translate(canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
    context.rotate((turns * Math.PI) / 2);
    context.drawImage(bitmap, -bitmap.width / 2, -bitmap.height / 2);
    bitmap.close();
    const drawn = await new Promise<Blob | null>((resolve) => canvas.toBlob(resolve, 'image/jpeg', 0.9));
    if (!drawn) {
      throw new Error('Not drawn');
    }
    return this.keep(URL.createObjectURL(drawn));
  }

  private keep(url: string): string {
    this.urls.push(url);
    return url;
  }

  private release(): void {
    this.urls.splice(0).forEach((url) => URL.revokeObjectURL(url));
  }
}

  fileName: string;

export class SalesPage {
  private readonly company = inject(Company);
  private readonly api = inject(MenuSalesApi);
  private readonly dialog = inject(MatDialog);
  private readonly notify = inject(NotifyService);
  private readonly businessDay = inject(BusinessDay);
  protected readonly approvals = inject(Approvals);
  protected readonly canChange = inject(AuthService).can(Permissions.InventoryManage);
  protected readonly shownLines = shownLines;

  // Opened from a stock card: the day of the sale, and its receipt, marked and every line shown.
  readonly day = input<string | undefined>(undefined);
  readonly receipt = input<string | undefined>(undefined);

  protected readonly from = signal('');
  protected readonly to = signal('');
  protected readonly report = signal<SalesReport | null>(null);
  protected readonly loading = signal(true);
  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  // The days whose every item is shown.
  protected readonly open = signal(new Set<string>());

  // Days with sales standing, voided ones left out.
  protected readonly days = computed(() => new Set((this.report()?.receipts ?? []).filter((r) => !r.voidedAtUtc).map((r) => r.businessDate)).size);

  constructor() {
    void (async () => {
      const day = this.day();
      if (day && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(day)) {
        this.from.set(day);
        this.to.set(day);
        const receipt = this.receipt();
        if (receipt) {
          this.open.set(new Set([receipt]));
        }
        await this.load();
        if (receipt) {
          setTimeout(() => document.getElementById(`sale-${receipt}`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }));
        }
        return;
      }
      const today = await this.businessDay.today();
      const weekAgo = new Date(`${today}T12:00:00`);
      weekAgo.setDate(weekAgo.getDate() - 6);
      this.to.set(today);
      this.from.set(weekAgo.toISOString().slice(0, 10));
      await this.load();
    })();
    void this.approvals.refresh();
  }

  protected pick(from: string, to: string): void {
    if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(from) && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(to) && from <= to) {
      this.from.set(from);
      this.to.set(to);
      void this.load();
    }
  }

  protected linesOf(sale: SalesReceipt) {
    return this.open().has(sale.id) ? sale.lines : sale.lines.slice(0, shownLines);
  }

  protected quantityOf(sale: SalesReceipt): number {
    return sale.lines.filter((l) => l.onBill).reduce((sum, l) => sum + l.quantity, 0);
  }

  protected toggle(id: string): void {
    this.open.update((open) => {
      const next = new Set(open);
      if (!next.delete(id)) {
        next.add(id);
      }
      return next;
    });
  }

  protected async enterDay(): Promise<void> {
    const menu = await firstValueFrom(this.api.menu());
    if (!menu.items.some((i) => !i.isDeleted)) {
      this.notify.error(null, 'The menu has no items yet: add them on Menu, or put recipes on it from Recipes. · أضف أصنافًا للمنيو أولًا.');
      return;
    }
    const sale = await firstValueFrom(
      this.dialog
        .open<DailySalesDialog, DailySalesDialogData, SalesReceipt>(DailySalesDialog, {
          data: { menu, today: await this.businessDay.today() },
          width: '760px',
          maxWidth: '96vw',
          // A day's items take a while to type: only Cancel or Save closes it.
          disableClose: true,
        })
        .afterClosed(),
    );
    if (sale) {
      this.notify.info(
        `Sales of ${sale.businessDate} saved: ${this.quantityOf(sale)} sold, ${this.company.money(sale.subtotal)} at menu prices, their stock taken.`,
      );
      await this.load();
    }
  }

  protected async importDay(): Promise<void> {
    const imported = await firstValueFrom(
      this.dialog
        .open<DailySalesImportDialog, { today: string }, boolean>(DailySalesImportDialog, {
          data: { today: await this.businessDay.today() },
          width: '640px',
          maxWidth: '96vw',
        })
        .afterClosed(),
    );
    if (imported) {
      await this.load();
    }
  }

  protected async voidSale(sale: SalesReceipt): Promise<void> {
    const what = sale.source === 'DailySummary' || !sale.reference ? `the sales of ${sale.businessDate}` : `sale ${sale.reference}`;
    if ((await this.approvals.delete('Sale', sale.id, what)) === 'Applied') {
      await this.load();
    }
  }

  private async load(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.report.set(await firstValueFrom(this.api.sales(this.from(), this.to())));
      this.error.set(null);
    } catch (error) {
      this.error.set(errorMessage(error, 'The sales could not be loaded.'));
    } finally {
      this.loading.set(false);
    }
  }
}

import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';
import { BulkSalesImport, DailySalesImportResult, Menu, MenuSalesApi, SalesReceipt } from '../../core/costing/menu-sales.api';
import { Company } from '../../core/settings/company';

import { ItemPicker, PickItem } from '../shared/item-picker';
import { errorMessage } from '../../core/http/error-message';
import { MoneyPipe } from '../../core/ui/money.pipe';
import { NotifyService } from '../../core/ui/notify.service';
import { saveBlob } from '../../core/ui/save-blob';
import { InfoTip } from './info-tip';

// What a day's sales are entered against: each item, and each size of one sold by size, by its
// code as the day's sheet lists it ("6101-2 · Margherita (Large)"), at the menu's price.
export interface SaleOption {
  label: string;
  menuItemId: number;
  variantId: number | null;
  price: number;
  // Its code ("6101", "6101-2") and its names, as they may be typed.
  code: string;
  names: string[];
}

const key = (text: string) => text.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toLowerCase();

export function saleOptions(menu: Menu): SaleOption[] {
  return menu.items
    .filter((i) => !i.isDeleted)
    .sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id)
    .flatMap((item): SaleOption[] =>
      item.sizes.length
        ? item.sizes.map((s) => ({
            label: `${item.id}-${s.id} · ${item.name} (${s.name})`,
            menuItemId: item.id,
            variantId: s.id,
            price: s.price,
            code: `${item.id}-${s.id}`,
            names: [`${item.name} (${s.name})`, ...(item.nameAr ? [`${item.nameAr} (${s.nameAr ?? s.name})`] : [])],
          }))
        : [{ label: `${item.id} · ${item.name}`, menuItemId: item.id, variantId: null, price: item.price, code: `${item.id}`, names: [item.name, ...(item.nameAr ? [item.nameAr] : [])] }],
    );
}

// The option typed: by its label as the list offers it, its code, or a name only one has.
export function findOption(options: SaleOption[], text: string): SaleOption | null {
  const typed = key(text);
  if (!typed) {
    return null;
  }
  const exact = options.find((o) => key(o.label) === typed || o.code === typed);
  if (exact) {
    return exact;
  }
  const named = options.filter((o) => o.names.some((n) => key(n) === typed));
  return named.length === 1 ? named[0] : null;
}

export interface DailySalesDialogData {
  menu: Menu;
  // The business day: the latest a day's sales can be of.
  today: string;
}

interface Row {
  // The option chosen, by its code ("6101-2").
  key: string | null;
  quantity: number | null;
}

export class DailySalesDialog {
  protected readonly data = inject<DailySalesDialogData>(MAT_DIALOG_DATA);
  private readonly ref = inject<MatDialogRef<DailySalesDialog, SalesReceipt>>(MatDialogRef);
  private readonly api = inject(MenuSalesApi);

  private readonly company = inject(Company);
  protected readonly options = saleOptions(this.data.menu);
  // As the picker offers them: by code, with the category and the menu's price.
  protected readonly pickItems: PickItem[] = this.options.map((o) => ({
    id: o.code, name: o.names[0], code: o.code, kind: 'menu', detail: this.data.menu.items.find((i) => i.id === o.menuItemId)?.category ?? null,
    cost: this.company.money(o.price), keywords: o.names,

  protected date = this.data.today;

  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  // Bumped as a row is typed into.
  private readonly version = signal(0);

  private readonly filled = computed(() => {

    return {
      items: new Set(good.map((r) => this.optionOf(r)!.code)).size,
      sold: good.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.quantity!, 0),
      value: good.reduce((sum, r) => sum + this.optionOf(r)!.price * r.quantity!, 0),
    };
  });

    const rows = this.filled();
    if (!this.date) {
      return 'Choose the date. · اختر التاريخ.';
    }
    if (this.date > this.data.today) {
      return 'That day has not come yet. · هذا اليوم لم يأتِ بعد.';
    }
    if (rows.length === 0) {
      return 'Add at least one item sold. · أضف صنفًا مباعًا واحدًا على الأقل.';
    }
    if (rows.some((r) => !this.optionOf(r))) {
      return 'Choose the item for each quantity from the list. · اختر الصنف لكل كمية من القائمة.';
    }
    if (rows.some((r) => !this.validQuantity(r))) {
      return 'Each quantity sold is a whole number, 1 or more. · الكمية رقم صحيح 1 أو أكثر.';
    }
    return null;
  });

  protected touch(): void {
    this.version.update((v) => v + 1);
  }

  protected optionOf(row: Row): SaleOption | null {
    return row.key ? (this.options.find((o) => o.code === row.key) ?? null) : null;
  }

  protected validQuantity(row: Row): boolean {
    return row.quantity !== null && Number.isInteger(Number(row.quantity)) && Number(row.quantity) >= 1;
  }

  protected add(): void {
    this.rows.update((rows) => [...rows, { key: null, quantity: null }]);
  }

  protected remove(index: number): void {
    this.rows.update((rows) => rows.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  }

  protected async save(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.problem()) {
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);
    try {
      const lines = this.filled().map((r) => {

        return { menuItemId: option.menuItemId, variantId: option.variantId, quantity: Number(r.quantity) };

            <strong>{{ r.items }} items, {{ r.quantity }} sold, {{ r.value | money }} at menu prices</strong>, recorded for {{ r.date }}: each took its
            stock by its recipe{{ r.discounts ? ', less ' + (r.discounts | money) + ' of discounts' : '' }}.
            <span class="note-ar" lang="ar" dir="rtl">تم تسجيل مبيعات اليوم وخصم المخزون بالوصفات.</span>
          </p>
        } @else {
          <p class="warn" role="status">Nothing on the sheet could be read: nothing was recorded. · لم يُسجل شيء.</p>
        }
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="left; context: { $implicit: r.skipped }" />
      } @else if (recorded(); as b) {
        <p class="note" role="status">
          <strong>{{ b.days.length }} {{ b.days.length === 1 ? 'day' : 'days' }} recorded</strong>, oldest first ({{ span(b) }}): each item took its stock by its
          recipe. {{ b.draftsCreated }} {{ b.draftsCreated === 1 ? 'day waits' : 'days wait' }} on End of the day as a draft, to be closed in turn.
          <span class="note-ar" lang="ar" dir="rtl">تم تسجيل مبيعات الأيام بالترتيب، وكل يوم ينتظر تقفيله.</span>
        </p>
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="days; context: { $implicit: b }" />
        <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="left; context: { $implicit: b.skipped }" />
      } @else {
        <div class="modes">
          <mat-button-toggle-group [value]="mode()" (change)="setMode($event.value)" hideSingleSelectionIndicator aria-label="How many days">
            <mat-button-toggle value="day">One day · يوم واحد</mat-button-toggle>
            <mat-button-toggle value="days">Multi-day Excel upload · عدة أيام</mat-button-toggle>
          </mat-button-toggle-group>
          <app-info-tip tip="bulkSalesImport" />
        </div>

            <span class="note-ar" lang="ar" dir="rtl">الصنف من قائمة المنيو والكمية المباعة. ملف لليوم المختار هنا.</span>
          </p>
          <div class="row">
            <mat-form-field class="day">
              <mat-label>Date · التاريخ</mat-label>
              <input matInput type="date" [(ngModel)]="date" [max]="data.today" required aria-label="Date" />
            </mat-form-field>
            <button mat-stroked-button type="button" (click)="template()"><mat-icon>download</mat-icon> Template <span class="inline-ar">النموذج</span></button>
          </div>
          <button mat-flat-button type="button" (click)="picker.click()" [disabled]="busy() || !date || date > data.today">
            <mat-icon>upload_file</mat-icon> Choose the sheet <span class="inline-ar">اختر الملف</span>
          </button>
        } @else {
          <p class="note">
            One sheet, several days: the Date (dd/MM/yyyy) on every row, the days one after another from the next day to close, none skipped.
            <span class="note-ar" lang="ar" dir="rtl">ملف واحد لعدة أيام: التاريخ في كل صف، والأيام متتالية من اليوم التالي للتقفيل بدون تخطي.</span>
          </p>
          <div class="row">
            <button mat-flat-button type="button" (click)="picker.click()" [disabled]="busy()">
              <mat-icon>upload_file</mat-icon> {{ file() ? 'Choose another sheet' : 'Choose the sheet' }} <span class="inline-ar">اختر الملف</span>
            </button>
            <button mat-stroked-button type="button" (click)="template()"><mat-icon>download</mat-icon> Template <span class="inline-ar">النموذج</span></button>
          </div>
          @if (preview(); as p) {
            @if (p.ok) {
              <p class="ok-line" role="status">
                Found {{ p.days.length }} {{ p.days.length === 1 ? 'day' : 'days' }} in file: {{ found(p) }}. This matches your next expected sequence. Proceed?
                <span class="note-ar" lang="ar" dir="rtl">تم العثور على {{ p.days.length }} أيام، وهي مطابقة لتسلسل النظام. هل تود الاستمرار؟</span>
              </p>
            } @else {
              <ul class="problems" role="alert">
                @for (problem of p.problems; track problem) {
                  <li>{{ problem }}</li>
                }
              </ul>
            }
            <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="days; context: { $implicit: p }" />
            <ng-container *ngTemplateOutlet="left; context: { $implicit: p.skipped }" />
          }
        }
        <input #picker type="file" accept=".xlsx" (change)="chosen($event)" hidden aria-label="The sales sheet" />
        @if (busy()) {
          <mat-progress-bar mode="indeterminate" />
        }
      }
      @if (error(); as message) {
        <p class="error" role="alert">{{ message }}</p>
      }

      <ng-template #days let-p>
        <table class="grid days" aria-label="Days in the sheet">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Date<span class="ar">التاريخ</span></th>
              <th class="num">Items<span class="ar">الأصناف</span></th>
              <th class="num">Sold<span class="ar">المباع</span></th>
              <th class="num">At menu prices<span class="ar">بأسعار المنيو</span></th>
              <th class="num">Discounts<span class="ar">الخصومات</span></th>
              <th class="num">Left out<span class="ar">صفوف مستبعدة</span></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (d of p.days; track d.date) {
              <tr>
                <td>{{ ddmm(d.date) }}</td>
                <td class="num">{{ d.items }}</td>
                <td class="num">{{ d.quantity }}</td>
                <td class="num">{{ d.value | money }}</td>
                <td class="num">{{ d.discounts | money }}</td>
                <td class="num">{{ d.skipped }}</td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </ng-template>

      <ng-template #left let-skipped>
        @if (skipped.length) {
          <h3>{{ skipped.length }} {{ skipped.length === 1 ? 'row' : 'rows' }} left out <span class="inline-ar">صفوف لم تُستورد</span></h3>
          <ul class="skipped">
            @for (s of skipped; track s.row) {
              <li>
                <strong>Row {{ s.row }}{{ s.name ? ' · ' + s.name : '' }}</strong>: {{ s.reason }}
                @if (s.reasonAr) {
                  <div class="reason-ar" lang="ar" dir="rtl">{{ s.reasonAr }}</div>
                }
              </li>
            }
          </ul>
        }
      </ng-template>
    </mat-dialog-content>
    <mat-dialog-actions align="end">
      @if (result() || recorded()) {
        <button mat-flat-button type="button" (click)="close()">Done <span class="inline-ar">تم</span></button>
      } @else {
        <button mat-button type="button" mat-dialog-close>Cancel <span class="inline-ar">إلغاء</span></button>
        @if (mode() === 'days' && preview()?.ok) {
          <button mat-flat-button type="button" (click)="proceed()" [disabled]="busy()">
            <mat-icon>playlist_add_check</mat-icon> Proceed · استمرار ({{ preview()!.days.length }})
          </button>
        }
      }
    </mat-dialog-actions>
  `,
  styleUrl: './costing.scss',
  styles: `
    .modes {

      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;

    }

      color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant);
    }
    h3 {
      margin: 12px 0 6px;
      font: var(--mat-sys-title-small);
    }
  `,
})
export class DailySalesImportDialog {
  protected readonly data = inject<{ today: string }>(MAT_DIALOG_DATA);
  private readonly ref = inject<MatDialogRef<DailySalesImportDialog, boolean>>(MatDialogRef);
  private readonly api = inject(MenuSalesApi);
  private readonly notify = inject(NotifyService);

  protected date = this.data.today;
  protected readonly mode = signal<ImportMode>('day');
  protected readonly busy = signal(false);
  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly result = signal<DailySalesImportResult | null>(null);
  // The multi-day sheet chosen, as previewed, and once recorded.
  protected readonly file = signal<File | null>(null);
  protected readonly preview = signal<BulkSalesImport | null>(null);
  protected readonly recorded = signal<BulkSalesImport | null>(null);

  protected setMode(mode: ImportMode): void {
    this.mode.set(mode);
    this.error.set(null);
  }

  protected ddmm(iso: string): string {
    return `${iso.slice(8, 10)}/${iso.slice(5, 7)}`;
  }

  // "15/11 (4 items, 45 sold), 16/11 (…)".
  protected found(p: BulkSalesImport): string {
    return p.days.map((d) => `${this.ddmm(d.date)} (${d.items} ${d.items === 1 ? 'item' : 'items'}, ${d.quantity} sold)`).join(', ');
  }

  protected span(p: BulkSalesImport): string {
    return p.days.length ? `${this.ddmm(p.days[0].date)} to ${this.ddmm(p.days[p.days.length - 1].date)}` : '';
  }

  protected async template(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      saveBlob(await firstValueFrom(this.api.dailySalesTemplate()), 'daily-sales-template.xlsx');
    } catch (error) {
      this.notify.error(error, 'The template could not be downloaded. · تعذّر تنزيل النموذج.');
    }
  }

  protected async chosen(event: Event): Promise<void> {
    const input = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
    const file = input.files?.[0];
    input.value = '';
    if (!file) {
      return;
    }
    await (this.mode() === 'day' ? this.import(file) : this.check(file));
  }

  protected async import(file: File): Promise<void> {
    await this.run(async () => this.result.set(await firstValueFrom(this.api.importDailySales(this.date, file))), 'The sheet could not be imported. · تعذّر استيراد الملف.');
  }

  // The multi-day sheet read and checked: nothing recorded yet.
  protected async check(file: File): Promise<void> {
    this.file.set(file);
    this.preview.set(null);
    await this.run(async () => this.preview.set(await firstValueFrom(this.api.previewBulkSales(file))), 'The sheet could not be read. · تعذّرت قراءة الملف.');
  }

  protected async proceed(): Promise<void> {
    const file = this.file();
    if (!file || !this.preview()?.ok) {
      return;
    }
    await this.run(async () => this.recorded.set(await firstValueFrom(this.api.bulkImportSales(file))), 'The days could not be imported. · تعذّر استيراد الأيام.');
  }

  private async run(call: () => Promise<void>, failed: string): Promise<void> {
    this.busy.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);
    try {
      await call();
    } catch (error) {
      this.error.set(errorMessage(error, failed));
    } finally {
      this.busy.set(false);
    }
  }

  protected close(): void {
    this.ref.close(!!this.result()?.saleId || !!this.recorded()?.recorded);
  }
}
```


## 13. الجرد

`CountsPage`: المسودة الحالية (إن وجدت) والجرود المرحّلة، وزرّان للبدء: افتتاحي وجرد شامل، وقوائم الجرد اليومي السريع بنقرة واحدة (الأصناف المحددة بالنجمة، الفئة A، الأكثر انحرافًا، حسب الفئة) من `count-presets`، وأنواع الجرد بشرح (ⓘ) لكلٍّ. و `CountSheetPage`: ورقة العد بالأقسام، **حفظ تلقائي** بعد آخر إدخال بمهلة قصيرة ("طويلة بما يكفي لكتابة رقم، قصيرة بما لا يضيع شيء إن وُضع التابلت")، وتغيير النوع، وقيمة المسودة بأسعار اليوم، والترحيل. وفيها **وضع الجرد الأعمى**: مفروض على من لا يرى التكاليف، ومفتاح لغيره، يخفي الدفتري والفرق والتكلفة ويترك الكمية والملاحظة، وطباعة كشف جرد أعمى، ثم **مراجعة الفروقات** للمراجِع (الأكبر قيمة أولًا، أحمر للعجز وكهرماني للزيادة خارج النسبة المسموحة) وإرسال سطور لإعادة الجرد. والنجمة على صفحتي الخامات والمصنّعات تضيف الصنف للجرد اليومي.

// (جرد افتتاحي): where stock begins, with no shortage or surplus; every one after is periodic

@Component({

export class CountsPage {
  protected readonly pendingLabel = pendingLabel;
  protected readonly kindLabels = countKindLabels;
  protected readonly scopeLabels = countScopeLabels;
  protected readonly reviewLabels = countReviewLabels;
  protected readonly presetIcons: Record<CountPreset['key'], string> = { critical: 'star', classA: 'workspace_premium', highVariance: 'trending_down' };
  private readonly api = inject(CostingApi);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly approvals = inject(Approvals);
  private readonly notify = inject(NotifyService);
  // Who reconciles a count handed in: who sees the costs.
  protected readonly canReconcile = inject(AuthService).can(Permissions.CostingView);

  // A spot count's ready lists, read once there is no draft open.
  protected readonly presets = signal<CountPresets | null>(null);
  protected readonly presetsError = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly starting = signal(false);

  protected readonly counts = signal<StockCountSummary[]>([]);
  protected readonly loading = signal(true);
  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);

  protected readonly draft = computed(() => this.counts().find((c) => c.status === 'Draft') ?? null);
  protected readonly posted = computed(() => this.counts().filter((c) => c.status === 'Posted'));
  // The variance report ends at a periodic count.
  protected readonly hasPeriodic = computed(() => this.posted().some((c) => c.kind === 'Periodic'));
  // Posted, and voided since: kept, marked so.
  protected readonly done = computed(() => this.counts().filter((c) => c.status !== 'Draft'));

  protected readonly search = signal('');
  protected readonly kind = signal('');
  protected readonly status = signal('');
  protected readonly sorts = countSorts;
  protected readonly sort = signal<SortState<CountSort>>({ key: 'date', direction: -1 });

  protected readonly kindFilters = computed<FilterOption[]>(() => [
    { value: '', label: 'All · الكل', count: this.done().length },
    ...(['Periodic', 'Opening'] as const).map((k) => ({
      value: k, label: `${countKindLabels[k].en} · ${countKindLabels[k].ar}`, count: this.done().filter((c) => c.kind === k).length,
    })),
  ]);

  protected readonly statusFilters = computed<FilterOption[]>(() => [
    { value: '', label: 'All · الكل', count: this.done().length },
    { value: 'Posted', label: 'Posted · مُرحّل', count: this.done().filter((c) => c.status === 'Posted').length },
    { value: 'Voided', label: 'Voided · ملغى', count: this.done().filter((c) => c.status === 'Voided').length },
  ]);

  protected readonly shownDone = computed(() =>
    sortItems(
      this.done().filter(
        (c) => (!this.kind() || c.kind === this.kind()) && (!this.status() || c.status === this.status()) && smartMatch(this.search(), c.startedBy, c.postedBy),
      ),
      this.sort(),
      (c, key) => (key === 'materials' ? c.materials : c.postedAtUtc),
    ),
  );

  constructor() {
    void this.load();
  }

  // Where the next count is counted: a location of the branch, or the whole branch (with locations only).
  protected readonly countAt = signal<string | null>(null);

  // A new count's id is made here; it is saved, of its kind, on its first entry.
  protected start(kind: StockCountKind): void {
    const location = locationParam(this.countAt());
    void this.router.navigate(['/costing/counts', crypto.randomUUID()], { queryParams: { kind, ...(location ? { location } : {}) } });
  }

  // A spot count started here, with what it covers, then counted on its sheet.
  protected async startSpot(materialIds: string[], label: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!materialIds.length) {
      return;
    }
    this.starting.set(true);
    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
    try {
      await firstValueFrom(
        this.api.saveStockCount(id, [], 'Periodic', { scope: 'Spot', scopeMaterialIds: materialIds, scopeLabel: label }, false, locationParam(this.countAt())),
      );
      void this.router.navigate(['/costing/counts', id]);
    } catch (error) {
      this.notify.error(error, 'The spot count could not be started.');
    } finally {
      this.starting.set(false);
    }
  }

  protected startCategory(categoryId: string): void {
    const category = this.presets()?.categories.find((c) => c.categoryId === categoryId);
    if (category) {
      void this.startSpot(category.materialIds, category.nameAr ? `${category.name} · ${category.nameAr}` : category.name);
    }
  }

  // A station's materials and prep items, for a count at its shift's close; printed blind from the sheet.
  protected startStation(stationId: string): void {
    const station = this.presets()?.stations?.find((s) => s.stationId === stationId);
    if (station) {
      void this.startSpot(station.materialIds, station.nameAr ? `${station.name} · ${station.nameAr}` : station.name);
    }
  }

  protected open(count: StockCountSummary): void {
    void this.router.navigate(['/costing/counts', count.id]);
  }

  protected pendingOf(count: StockCountSummary): ApprovalRequest | undefined {
    return this.approvals.pendingFor(count.id);
  }

  // Voided for a manager (its adjustments undone); asked of one for anyone else.
  protected async remove(count: StockCountSummary): Promise<void> {
    const day = new Date(count.postedAtUtc!).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
    const what = count.kind === 'Opening' ? `the opening stock of ${day}` : `the count of ${day}`;
    if ((await this.approvals.delete('StockCount', count.id, what)) === 'Applied') {
      await this.load();
    }
  }

  private async load(): Promise<void> {
    void this.approvals.refresh();
    try {
      this.counts.set(await firstValueFrom(this.api.stockCounts()));
      if (!this.draft()) {
        void this.loadPresets();
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.error.set(errorMessage(error, 'The stock counts could not be loaded.'));
    } finally {
      this.loading.set(false);
    }
  }

  private async loadPresets(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      this.presets.set(await firstValueFrom(this.api.countPresets()));
    } catch (error) {
      this.presetsError.set(errorMessage(error, 'The spot count lists could not be loaded.'));
    }
  }
}

//

// copy. A storekeeper always counts blind (the API sends them no figure) and hands the count in; a
// manager, cost controller or accountant may count blind too (a toggle), and otherwise sees each

            <span>
              @if (forcedBlind()) {
                Handed in for review {{ c.submittedAtUtc | date: 'd MMM, HH:mm' }}: a manager or cost controller reconciles it and posts it.
                <span class="inline-ar">{{ reviewLabels.Submitted.ar }}</span>
              } @else {
                Handed in by <strong>{{ c.submittedBy }}</strong> {{ c.submittedAtUtc | date: 'd MMM, HH:mm' }}: reconcile it below, then post it or
                send lines back. <span class="inline-ar">راجع الفروقات ثم رحّل أو اطلب إعادة الجرد</span>
              }
            </span>
          </p>
        }
      }

      <div class="toolbar sticky">
        <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="find">
          <mat-label>Find · بحث</mat-label>
          <input matInput [ngModel]="search()" (ngModelChange)="search.set($event)" />
        </mat-form-field>
        @if (stationOptions().length > 2) {
          <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="find">
            <mat-label>By station · حسب قسم المطبخ</mat-label>
            <mat-select [ngModel]="station()" (ngModelChange)="station.set($event)" aria-label="Show one station">
              @for (o of stationOptions(); track o.value) {
                <mat-option [value]="o.value">{{ o.label }} ({{ o.count }})</mat-option>
              }
            </mat-select>
          </mat-form-field>
        }
        <span class="progress">
          {{ countedCount() }} of {{ materials().length }} counted<span class="muted"> (empty is not counted, 0 is none left)</span>
          @if (kind() === 'Opening' && !blind()) {
            <span class="worth">
              · worth {{ draftValue().value | money }} at today's costs
              @if (draftValue().unpriced) {
                <span class="muted">({{ draftValue().unpriced }} with no price)</span>
              }
              <span class="inline-ar">القيمة بتكلفة اليوم</span>
            </span>
          }
          <span class="muted save-state">· {{ saveState() }}</span>
        </span>
        <span class="blind-mode">
          @if (forcedBlind()) {
            <span class="blind-badge"><mat-icon>visibility_off</mat-icon> Blind count · جرد أعمى</span>
          } @else {
            <mat-slide-toggle [checked]="blindChoice()" (change)="chooseBlind($event.checked)">
              Blind entry mode · وضع الجرد الأعمى <span class="muted small">(إخفاء الرصيد الدفتري أثناء الإدخال)</span>
            </mat-slide-toggle>
          }
          <app-info-tip tip="countBlind" />
        </span>
        <span class="spacer"></span>
        <button mat-button (click)="printBlindSheet()"><mat-icon>print</mat-icon> Print blind sheet · طباعة كشف جرد أعمى</button>
        @if (confirming() === 'post') {
          <span>
            @if (kind() === 'Opening') {
              Open the stock of {{ countedCount() }} {{ countedCount() === 1 ? 'material' : 'materials' }} at what was counted, with no shortage or
              surplus?
            } @else {
              Set stock to what was counted for {{ countedCount() }} {{ countedCount() === 1 ? 'material' : 'materials' }}?
            }
            @if (materials().length - countedCount() > 0) {
              {{ materials().length - countedCount() }} not counted keep their stock.
            }
            @if (recountCount()) {
              <strong class="warn-text">{{ recountCount() }} still to weigh again.</strong>
            }
          </span>
          <button mat-button (click)="confirming.set(null)">Keep counting</button>
          <button mat-flat-button (click)="post()" [disabled]="busy()">{{ kind() === 'Opening' ? 'Post the opening stock' : 'Post the count' }}</button>
        } @else if (confirming() === 'discard') {
          <span>Throw this count away?</span>
          <button mat-button (click)="confirming.set(null)">Keep it</button>
          <button mat-flat-button class="danger" (click)="discard()" [disabled]="busy()">Discard</button>
        } @else {
          @if (saved()) {
            <button mat-button (click)="confirming.set('discard')"><mat-icon>delete</mat-icon> Discard</button>
          }
          @if (forcedBlind()) {
            <button mat-flat-button (click)="submit()" [disabled]="countedCount() === 0 || busy()">
              <mat-icon>send</mat-icon>
              {{ count()?.review === 'Submitted' ? 'Hand in again · إعادة الإرسال للمراجعة' : 'Hand in for review · إرسال للمراجعة' }}
            </button>
          } @else {
            <button mat-flat-button (click)="confirming.set('post')" [disabled]="countedCount() === 0 || busy()">
              <mat-icon>fact_check</mat-icon> {{ kind() === 'Opening' ? 'Post the opening stock' : 'Post the count' }}
            </button>
          }
        }
      </div>
      @if (problem(); as p) {
        <p class="error">{{ p }}</p>
      }

      @if (!blind() && reconcileRows().length) {
        <section class="reconcile" aria-labelledby="reconcile-title">
          <h3 id="reconcile-title">
            Reconciliation · مراجعة الفروقات
            <span class="muted small">tolerance ±{{ tolerance() | number: '1.0-1' }}%</span>
          </h3>
          <div class="table-wrap">
            <table class="grid reconcile-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th><span class="visually-hidden">Recount</span></th>
                  <th>Material<span class="ar">الخامة</span></th>
                  <th class="num">Book<span class="ar">الرصيد الدفتري</span></th>
                  <th class="num">Counted<span class="ar">الكمية الفعلية</span></th>
                  <th class="num">Variance<span class="ar">الفرق / العجز والزيادة</span></th>
                  <th class="num">Unit cost<span class="ar">تكلفة الوحدة</span></th>
                  <th class="num">Variance value <app-info-tip tip="countVarianceValue" /><span class="ar">قيمة الفرق</span></th>
                  <th>Note<span class="ar">ملاحظة</span></th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                @for (row of reconcileRows(); track row.id) {
                  <tr [class.short]="row.flag === 'short'" [class.over]="row.flag === 'over'">
                    <td>
                      <mat-checkbox [checked]="recountPick().has(row.id)" (change)="pickRecount(row.id, $event.checked)"
                        [attr.aria-label]="'Recount ' + row.name" />
                    </td>
                    <td>
                      {{ row.name }}
                      @if (row.code) {
                        <small class="muted">{{ row.code }}</small>
                      }
                      @if (row.recountRequested) {
                        <span class="recount-badge">Recount needed · مطلوب إعادة جرد</span>
                      }
                    </td>
                    <td class="num">{{ row.book === null ? '—' : (row.book | number: '1.0-3') + ' ' + row.unit }}</td>
                    <td class="num">{{ row.counted | number: '1.0-3' }} {{ row.unit }}</td>
                    <td class="num">
                      @if (row.difference === null) {
                        —
                      } @else {
                        {{ row.difference > 0 ? '+' : '' }}{{ row.difference | number: '1.0-3' }} {{ row.unit }}
                        @if (row.flag === 'short') {
                          <span class="flag short">Short · عجز</span>
                        } @else if (row.flag === 'over') {
                          <span class="flag over">Over · زيادة</span>
                        }
                      }
                    </td>
                    <td class="num">{{ row.unitCost === null ? '—' : (row.unitCost | money) + ' / ' + row.unit }}</td>
                    <td class="num">{{ row.value === null ? '—' : (row.value | money) }}</td>
                    <td class="note-cell">{{ row.note ?? '' }}</td>
                  </tr>
                }
              </tbody>
              <tfoot>
                <tr>
                  <td colspan="6">Net variance · صافي الفرق</td>
                  <td class="num">{{ reconcileTotal() | money }}</td>
                  <td></td>
                </tr>
              </tfoot>
            </table>
          </div>
          <div class="recount-actions">
            <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="recount-note">
              <mat-label>Note to the counter · ملاحظة للقائم بالجرد</mat-label>
              <input matInput maxlength="300" [ngModel]="recountNote()" (ngModelChange)="recountNote.set($event)" placeholder="Weigh the beef again: the scale was off" />
            </mat-form-field>
            <button mat-stroked-button (click)="requestRecount()" [disabled]="!recountPick().size || busy()">
              <mat-icon>replay</mat-icon> Recount needed · مطلوب إعادة جرد ({{ recountPick().size }})
            </button>
          </div>
        </section>
      }

      @for (section of sections(); track section.category) {
        <h3 class="category">{{ section.category }}</h3>
        <div class="sheet">
          @for (m of section.materials; track m.id) {
            <div class="item" [class.done]="isCounted(m.id)" [class.recount]="recountAsked(m.id)">
              <div class="item-head">
                <span class="name">
                  {{ m.name }}
                  @if (m.code) {
                    <small class="muted">{{ m.code }}</small>
                  }
                </span>
                @if (recountAsked(m.id)) {
                  <span class="recount-badge">Recount needed · مطلوب إعادة جرد</span>
                }
                @if (!blind() && bookOf(m.id); as book) {
                  <small class="book">Book · الدفتري {{ book }}</small>
                }
              </div>
              <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="qty">
                <input matInput type="number" min="0" step="any" inputmode="decimal" placeholder="—"
                  [ngModel]="counted()[m.id]" (ngModelChange)="enter(m.id, $event)" [attr.aria-label]="m.name + ', counted in ' + unitOf(m)" />
                <span matTextSuffix>&nbsp;{{ unitOf(m) }}</span>
              </mat-form-field>
              <input class="line-note" maxlength="200" placeholder="Note · ملاحظة" [ngModel]="notes()[m.id] ?? ''" (ngModelChange)="note(m.id, $event)"
                [attr.aria-label]="m.name + ', note'" />
            </div>
          }
        </div>
      } @empty {
        <p class="note">No raw materials match.</p>
      }
    }
  `,
  styleUrl: './costing.scss',
  styles: `
    .kind-choice {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;

      .kind-note {
        flex: 1 1 320px;
        margin: 0;
      }
    }
    .scope-line {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      margin: 0 0 8px;
    }
    .scope-badge,
    .blind-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      padding: 2px 10px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font: var(--mat-sys-label-medium);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-primary) 12%, transparent);
      color: var(--mat-sys-primary);

      mat-icon {
        width: 16px;
        height: 16px;
        font-size: 16px;
      }
    }
    .review-banner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 0 0 8px;
      padding: 10px 14px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      font: var(--mat-sys-body-medium);

      mat-icon {
        flex: none;
      }
      &.recount {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-warn) 16%, transparent);
        color: var(--app-warn);
      }
      &.submitted {
        background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-primary) 10%, transparent);
      }
    }
    .worth {
      margin-inline-start: 4px;
    }
    .title {
      margin: 0 0 4px;
      font: var(--mat-sys-title-large);
    }
    .sticky {
      position: sticky;
      top: 64px;
      z-index: 2;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      padding: 8px 0;
      background: var(--mat-sys-surface);
    }
    .find {
      width: 180px;
    }
    .blind-mode {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .progress {
      font: var(--mat-sys-title-small);
    }
    .small {
      font-size: 0.8em;
    }
    .warn-text {
      color: var(--app-warn);
    }
    .category {
      margin: 16px 0 8px;
      font: var(--mat-sys-title-small);
      color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant);
    }
    .sheet {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .item {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px 8px;
      padding: 6px 6px 6px 12px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      border: 1px solid var(--mat-sys-outline-variant);
      background: var(--mat-sys-surface);

      &.done {
        border-color: var(--mat-sys-primary);
      }
      &.recount {
        border-color: var(--app-warn);
        box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--app-warn);
      }
      .item-head {
        display: grid;
        gap: 2px;
        min-width: 0;
      }
      .name {
        display: grid;
      }
      .book {
        color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant);
      }
      .line-note {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        min-width: 0;
        padding: 4px 8px;
        border: 1px dashed var(--mat-sys-outline-variant);
        border-radius: 8px;
        background: transparent;
        font: var(--mat-sys-body-small);
        color: inherit;
      }
    }
    .recount-badge {
      justify-self: start;
      padding: 1px 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font: var(--mat-sys-label-small);
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-warn) 18%, transparent);
      color: var(--app-warn);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .qty {
      width: 150px;
      flex: none;
    }
    .reconcile {
      margin: 8px 0 16px;

      h3 {
        margin: 0 0 6px;
        font: var(--mat-sys-title-small);
      }
      tr.short td:first-child {
        box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--mat-sys-error);
      }
      tr.over td:first-child {
        box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--app-warn);
      }
      .flag {
        display: inline-block;
        margin-inline-start: 6px;
        padding: 0 8px;
        border-radius: 999px;
        font: var(--mat-sys-label-small);

        &.short {
          background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-error) 14%, transparent);
          color: var(--mat-sys-error);
        }
        &.over {
          background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-warn) 18%, transparent);
          color: var(--app-warn);
        }
      }
      .note-cell {
        max-width: 220px;
        color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant);
      }
    }
    .recount-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }
    .recount-note {
      flex: 1 1 280px;
      max-width: 480px;
    }
    .danger {
      --mat-button-filled-container-color: var(--mat-sys-error);
      --mat-button-filled-label-text-color: var(--mat-sys-on-error);
    }
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .sheet {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      }
      .qty {
        width: 130px;
      }
    }
  `,
})
export class CountSheetPage {
  private readonly api = inject(CostingApi);
  private readonly notify = inject(NotifyService);
  private readonly router = inject(Router);
  private readonly auth = inject(AuthService);
  private readonly company = inject(Company);
  protected readonly kindLabels = countKindLabels;
  protected readonly scopeLabels = countScopeLabels;
  protected readonly reviewLabels = countReviewLabels;

  // From the route: /costing/counts/:id. A new count's id, before its first save, finds nothing.
  readonly id = input.required<string>();
  // From the query: the kind a new count starts as (?kind=Opening).
  readonly kindParam = input<string | undefined>(undefined, { alias: 'kind' });
  // The location a new count is counted in, as the counts page chose it; none: the whole branch.
  readonly locationQuery = input<string | undefined>(undefined, { alias: 'location' });
  protected readonly places = inject(StockPlaces);
  protected readonly kind = signal<StockCountKind>('Periodic');

  // Who does not see the costs counts blind, always; anyone else when they choose to.
  protected readonly forcedBlind = computed(() => !this.auth.can(Permissions.CostingView));
  protected readonly blindChoice = signal(readBlindChoice());
  protected readonly blind = computed(() => this.forcedBlind() || this.blindChoice());

  // What the sheet lists, each with its costs when the user may see them.
  protected readonly materials = signal<MaterialCost[]>([]);
  protected readonly count = signal<StockCount | null>(null);
  protected readonly tolerance = signal(5);
  protected readonly loading = signal(true);
  protected readonly busy = signal(false);
  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly problem = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly confirming = signal<'post' | 'discard' | null>(null);
  protected readonly search = signal('');
  // One station's materials shown (and printed on the blind sheet), for a count at its shift's close.
  protected readonly station = signal('');
  protected readonly stations = inject(Stations);
  protected readonly stationOptions = computed(() => this.stations.filter(this.materials(), (m) => m.kitchenStationId));

  // By material id, in kg, litres or pieces; null or absent is not counted.
  protected readonly counted = signal<Record<string, number | null>>({});
  protected readonly notes = signal<Record<string, string | undefined>>({});
  // Whether the draft exists on the server yet.
  protected readonly saved = signal(false);
  protected readonly saveState = signal('Nothing entered yet');

  // The reviewer's picks to weigh again, and their word to the counter.
  protected readonly recountPick = signal(new Set<string>());
  protected readonly recountNote = signal('');

  // Posted, or voided since: either way read-only.
  protected readonly posted = computed(() => (this.count() && this.count()!.status !== 'Draft' ? this.count() : null));
  protected readonly isSpot = computed(() => this.count()?.scope === 'Spot');
  // Where it is counted: its location, or the whole branch.
  protected readonly countedIn = computed(() => {
    const id = this.count()?.locationId ?? this.locationQuery() ?? null;
    return id ? this.places.name(id) || 'Location' : 'Whole branch · كل الفرع';
  });

  protected readonly countedCount = computed(() => Object.values(this.counted()).filter((v) => this.valid(v)).length);
  protected readonly recountCount = computed(() => (this.count()?.lines ?? []).filter((l) => l.recountRequested).length);

  protected readonly sections = computed<Section[]>(() => {
    const needle = this.search().trim().toLowerCase();
    const shown = this.materials().filter(
      (m) => (!needle || [m.name, m.code, m.category].some((v) => v?.toLowerCase().includes(needle))) && this.stations.matches(this.station(), m.kitchenStationId),
    );
    const byCategory = new Map<string, MaterialCost[]>();
    for (const m of shown) {
      const category = m.category ?? 'Other · أخرى';
      byCategory.set(category, [...(byCategory.get(category) ?? []), m]);
    }
    return [...byCategory.entries()]
      .sort(([a], [b]) => (a.startsWith('Other') ? 1 : b.startsWith('Other') ? -1 : a.localeCompare(b)))
      .map(([category, materials]) => ({ category, materials }));
  });

  // Each counted line against the records, the furthest out (by worth, then share) first.
  protected readonly reconcileRows = computed<ReconcileRow[]>(() => {
    const lines = new Map((this.count()?.lines ?? []).map((l) => [l.rawMaterialId, l]));
    const tolerance = this.tolerance();
    return this.materials()
      .filter((m) => this.valid(this.counted()[m.id]))
      .map((m) => {
        const size = this.sizeOf(m);
        const line = lines.get(m.id);
        const counted = this.counted()[m.id]!;
        const book = line?.bookQuantity ?? null;
        const difference = book === null ? null : counted - book / size;
        const share = book === null || difference === null ? 0 : book > 0 ? (Math.abs(difference * size) / book) * 100 : difference !== 0 ? Infinity : 0;
        return {
          id: m.id,
          code: m.code,
          name: m.name,
          category: m.category,
          unit: this.unitOf(m),
          counted,
          book: book === null ? null : book / size,
          difference,
          unitCost: line?.unitCost == null ? null : line.unitCost * size,
          value: difference === null || line?.unitCost == null ? null : difference * size * line.unitCost,
          flag: difference !== null && share > tolerance ? (difference < 0 ? ('short' as const) : ('over' as const)) : null,
          note: this.notes()[m.id] || null,
          recountRequested: !!line?.recountRequested,
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.value ?? 0) - Math.abs(a.value ?? 0) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  });

  protected readonly reconcileTotal = computed(() => this.reconcileRows().reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.value ?? 0), 0));

  protected readonly postedRows = computed(() => {
    const count = this.posted();
    if (!count) {
      return [];
    }
    return count.lines
      .map((line) => {
        const m = this.materials().find((x) => x.id === line.rawMaterialId);
        const unit = m ? countUnit(m.unit, m.purchaseUnitSize) : { label: '', size: 1 };
        const difference = line.countedQuantity - (line.bookQuantity ?? 0);
        return {
          id: line.rawMaterialId,
          code: m?.code ?? null,
          name: m?.name ?? 'A removed material',
          unit: unit.label,
          counted: line.countedQuantity / unit.size,
          book: (line.bookQuantity ?? 0) / unit.size,
          difference: difference / unit.size,
          value: line.unitCost === null ? null : difference * line.unitCost,
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.value ?? 0) - Math.abs(a.value ?? 0));
  });

  protected readonly postedTotal = computed(() => this.postedRows().reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.value ?? 0), 0));

  // A count posted, seen blind: what was counted, nothing more.
  protected readonly blindRows = computed(() =>
    (this.posted()?.lines ?? [])
      .map((line) => {
        const m = this.materials().find((x) => x.id === line.rawMaterialId);
        const unit = m ? countUnit(m.unit, m.purchaseUnitSize) : { label: '', size: 1 };
        return { id: line.rawMaterialId, code: m?.code ?? null, name: m?.name ?? 'A removed material', unit: unit.label, counted: line.countedQuantity / unit.size };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)),
  );

  // The opening stock posted: each material at what it was counted at, and the cost it opened at.
  protected readonly openingRows = computed(() => {
    const count = this.posted();
    if (!count) {
      return [];
    }
    return count.lines
      .map((line) => {
        const m = this.materials().find((x) => x.id === line.rawMaterialId);
        const unit = m ? countUnit(m.unit, m.purchaseUnitSize) : { label: '', size: 1 };
        return {
          id: line.rawMaterialId,
          code: m?.code ?? null,
          name: m?.name ?? 'A removed material',
          unit: unit.label,
          counted: line.countedQuantity / unit.size,
          cost: line.unitCost === null ? null : line.unitCost * unit.size,
          worth: line.unitCost === null ? null : line.countedQuantity * line.unitCost,
        };
      })
      .sort((a, b) => (b.worth ?? -1) - (a.worth ?? -1) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  });

  protected readonly openingTotal = computed(() => this.openingRows().reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.worth ?? 0), 0));
  protected readonly openingUnpriced = computed(() => this.openingRows().filter((r) => r.worth === null).length);

  // An opening stock being filled in, at today's costs: a prep item never made at its recipe's.
  protected readonly draftValue = computed(() => {
    const byId = new Map(this.materials().map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    let value = 0;
    let unpriced = 0;
    for (const [id, quantity] of Object.entries(this.counted())) {
      const m = byId.get(id);
      if (!m || !this.valid(quantity)) {
        continue;
      }
      const cost = recipeCostOf(m);
      if (cost === null) {
        unpriced++;
      } else {
        value += quantity * this.sizeOf(m) * cost;
      }
    }
    return { value, unpriced };
  });

  private saveTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private saving: Promise<void> | null = null;
  private dirty = false;
  // Every material, before a spot count narrows the sheet to what it covers.
  private allMaterials: MaterialCost[] = [];

  constructor() {
    void this.stations.load();
    void this.places.load();
    effect(() => {
      const id = this.id();
      untracked(() => void this.load(id));
    });
    // Leaving with entries not yet saved: saved on the way out.
    inject(DestroyRef).onDestroy(() => {
      if (this.dirty) {
        void this.saveNow();
      }
    });
  }

  protected unitOf(material: MaterialCost): string {
    return countUnit(material.unit, material.purchaseUnitSize).label;
  }

  protected isCounted(id: string): boolean {
    return this.valid(this.counted()[id]);
  }

  protected recountAsked(id: string): boolean {
    return !!this.count()?.lines.find((l) => l.rawMaterialId === id)?.recountRequested;
  }

  // What the records say now, as the reviewer sees it beside the field: "12.5 kg".
  protected bookOf(id: string): string | null {
    const line = this.count()?.lines.find((l) => l.rawMaterialId === id);
    const m = this.materials().find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (line?.bookQuantity == null || !m) {
      return null;
    }
    return `${(line.bookQuantity / this.sizeOf(m)).toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 3 })} ${this.unitOf(m)}`;
  }

  protected enter(id: string, value: number | null | string): void {
    const quantity = value === '' || value === null ? null : Number(value);
    this.counted.update((counted) => ({ ...counted, [id]: quantity }));
    this.changed();
  }

  protected note(id: string, value: string): void {
    this.notes.update((notes) => ({ ...notes, [id]: value }));
    if (this.isCounted(id)) {
      this.changed();
    }
  }

  // Blind, or not, on this device: the count read again with the records' figures, or without.
  protected async chooseBlind(blind: boolean): Promise<void> {
    this.blindChoice.set(blind);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(blindKey, blind ? '1' : '0');
    } catch {
      // Kept for this visit only.
    }
    if (this.saved()) {
      try {
        const count = await firstValueFrom(this.api.stockCount(this.id(), this.blind()));
        if (count) {
          this.count.set(count);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        this.problem.set(errorMessage(error, 'The count could not be read again.'));
      }
    }
  }

  protected pickRecount(id: string, picked: boolean): void {
    this.recountPick.update((pick) => {
      const next = new Set(pick);
      if (picked) {
        next.add(id);
      } else {
        next.delete(id);
      }
      return next;
    });
  }

  // Told it is the other kind: saved so, if it is saved already; else its first save says it.
  protected chooseKind(kind: StockCountKind): void {
    if (kind === this.kind()) {
      return;
    }
    this.kind.set(kind);
    this.problem.set(null);
    if (this.saved() || this.countedCount() > 0) {
      this.dirty = true;
      this.saveState.set('Not saved yet');
      void this.saveNow();
    }
  }

  protected async post(): Promise<void> {
    this.busy.set(true);
    this.problem.set(null);
    try {
      await this.saveNow();
      if (this.problem()) {
        return;
      }
      const count = await firstValueFrom(this.api.postStockCount(this.id()));
      this.count.set(count);
      this.confirming.set(null);
      this.notify.info(
        count.kind === 'Opening'
          ? 'Opening stock posted: stock starts from what was counted. · تم ترحيل الجرد الافتتاحي.'
          : count.scope === 'Spot'
            ? 'Spot count posted: only the materials counted moved. · تم ترحيل الجرد السريع.'
            : 'Count posted: stock is set to what was counted.',
      );
    } catch (error) {
      this.problem.set(errorMessage(error, 'The count could not be posted.'));
    } finally {
      this.busy.set(false);
    }
  }

  // Handed in for a manager or cost controller to reconcile and post.
  protected async submit(): Promise<void> {
    this.busy.set(true);
    this.problem.set(null);
    try {
      await this.saveNow();
      if (this.problem()) {
        return;
      }
      this.count.set(await firstValueFrom(this.api.submitStockCount(this.id(), this.blind())));
      this.notify.info('Handed in for review: a manager or cost controller reconciles and posts it. · تم الإرسال للمراجعة.');
    } catch (error) {
      this.problem.set(errorMessage(error, 'The count could not be handed in.'));
    } finally {
      this.busy.set(false);
    }
  }

  // The picked lines sent back to be weighed again, with the note; never with the figure.
  protected async requestRecount(): Promise<void> {
    const ids = [...this.recountPick()];
    if (!ids.length) {
      return;
    }
    this.busy.set(true);
    this.problem.set(null);
    try {
      await this.saveNow();
      this.count.set(await firstValueFrom(this.api.requestRecount(this.id(), ids, this.recountNote().trim() || null)));
      this.recountPick.set(new Set());
      this.recountNote.set('');
      this.notify.info(`${ids.length === 1 ? '1 line' : ids.length + ' lines'} sent back to be weighed again. · تم طلب إعادة الجرد.`);
    } catch (error) {
      this.problem.set(errorMessage(error, 'The recount could not be asked for.'));
    } finally {
      this.busy.set(false);
    }
  }

  protected async discard(): Promise<void> {
    this.busy.set(true);
    try {
      this.cancelAutosave();
      await firstValueFrom(this.api.discardStockCount(this.id()));
      this.notify.info('Count discarded.');
      void this.router.navigate(['/costing/counts']);
    } catch (error) {
      this.problem.set(errorMessage(error, 'The count could not be discarded.'));
    } finally {
      this.busy.set(false);
    }
  }

  protected print(): void {
    window.print();
  }

  // A blind sheet for counting on paper (كشف جرد أعمى): code, material, category and unit, a box
  // for the count and a line for a note, and the signatures; nothing of the records. In its own
  // window, so it prints as a sheet and not as the screen.
  protected printBlindSheet(): void {
    const sheet = window.open('', '_blank');
    if (!sheet) {
      this.notify.error(null, 'The browser stopped the sheet opening: allow pop-ups for this site, then print again.');
      return;
    }
    const count = this.count();
    const title = `${this.isSpot() ? 'Spot count · جرد يومي سريع' : this.kind() === 'Opening' ? 'Opening stock · جرد افتتاحي' : 'Periodic count · جرد دوري'}${
      this.station() ? ` · ${this.station() === NoStation ? 'Shared / General' : this.stations.label(this.station())}` : ''
    }`;
    const rows = this.sections()
      .map(
        (s) =>
          `<tr class="group"><td colspan="6">${escape(s.category)}</td></tr>` +
          s.materials
            .map(
              (m) =>
                `<tr><td>${escape(m.code ?? '')}</td><td>${escape(m.name)}</td><td>${escape(m.category ?? '')}</td><td>${escape(this.unitOf(m))}</td>` +
                `<td class="box"></td><td class="box wide"></td></tr>`,
            )
            .join(''),
      )
      .join('');
    sheet.document.write(`<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Blind count sheet · كشف جرد أعمى</title><style>
      body { font: 12px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 24px; color: #111; }
      h1 { font-size: 18px; margin: 0 0 4px; } p { margin: 0 0 12px; color: #444; }
      table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } th, td { border: 1px solid #999; padding: 6px 8px; text-align: start; }
      th { background: #eee; } tr.group td { background: #f5f5f5; font-weight: 600; }
      td.box { width: 90px; height: 22px; } td.box.wide { width: 180px; }
      .signatures { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; margin-top: 32px; }
      .signatures div { border-top: 1px solid #111; padding-top: 4px; }
      @page { margin: 14mm; }
    </style></head><body>
      <h1>${escape(this.company.name())} — Blind count sheet · كشف جرد أعمى</h1>
      <p>${escape(title)}${count?.scopeLabel ? ' — ' + escape(count.scopeLabel) : ''} · ${escape(new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }))}
        · Count what is on the shelf; write the quantity in the unit shown. · اكتب الكمية الفعلية بالوحدة الموضحة.</p>
      <table><thead><tr><th>Code · الكود</th><th>Material · الخامة</th><th>Category · القسم</th><th>Unit · الوحدة</th>
        <th>Counted · الكمية الفعلية</th><th>Note · ملاحظة</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>
      <div class="signatures"><div>Counted by · القائم بالجرد</div><div>Signature · التوقيع</div><div>Reviewed by · المراجع</div></div>
    </body></html>`);
    sheet.document.close();
    sheet.focus();
    sheet.print();
  }

  private changed(): void {
    this.problem.set(null);
    this.dirty = true;
    this.saveState.set('Not saved yet');
    if (this.saveTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.saveTimer);
    }
    this.saveTimer = setTimeout(() => void this.saveNow(), autosaveAfterMs);
  }

  // Saves the sheet as it stands. One save at a time; entries made during it are saved after.
  private async saveNow(): Promise<void> {
    this.cancelAutosave();
    if (this.saving) {
      await this.saving;
      if (!this.dirty) {
        return;
      }
    }
    if (!this.dirty && this.saved()) {
      return;
    }
    this.saving = this.send();
    try {
      await this.saving;
    } finally {
      this.saving = null;
    }
  }

  private async send(): Promise<void> {
    const materials = new Map(this.materials().map((m) => [m.id, m]));
    const lines = Object.entries(this.counted())
      .filter(([id, v]) => this.valid(v) && materials.has(id))
      .map(([id, v]) => {
        const line: { rawMaterialId: string; countedQuantity: number; note?: string } = {
          rawMaterialId: id,
          countedQuantity: Math.round(v! * this.sizeOf(materials.get(id)!) * 1000) / 1000,
        };
        const note = this.notes()[id]?.trim();
        if (note) {
          line.note = note;
        }
        return line;
      });
    this.dirty = false;
    this.saveState.set('Saving…');
    try {
      const saved = await firstValueFrom(
        this.api.saveStockCount(this.id(), lines, this.kind(), undefined, this.blind(), this.count() ? null : (this.locationQuery() ?? null)),
      );
      // The records' figures as they stand now, for the reviewer; the review as it stands.
      if (saved) {
        this.count.set(saved);
      }
      this.saved.set(true);
      this.saveState.set(`Saved ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}`);
    } catch (error) {
      this.dirty = true;
      this.saveState.set('Not saved');
      this.problem.set(errorMessage(error, 'The count could not be saved. Your entries are still here; they are saved with the next one.'));
    }
  }

  private cancelAutosave(): void {
    if (this.saveTimer) {
      clearTimeout(this.saveTimer);
      this.saveTimer = null;
    }
  }

  private sizeOf(material: MaterialCost): number {
    return countUnit(material.unit, material.purchaseUnitSize).size;
  }

  private valid(value: number | null | undefined): value is number {
    return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0;
  }

  // What a sheet lists: every material and prep item (nothing of its stock or cost), each with its
  // costs when the user may see them (the opening stock's worth); a spot count's alone.
  private async load(id: string): Promise<void> {
    this.error.set(null);
    try {
      const seesCosts = !this.forcedBlind();
      const [items, costs, read, settings] = await Promise.all([
        firstValueFrom(this.api.countItems()),
        seesCosts ? firstValueFrom(this.api.materials()) : Promise.resolve([] as MaterialCost[]),
        firstValueFrom(this.api.stockCount(id, this.blind())),
        seesCosts ? firstValueFrom(this.api.settings()).catch(() => null) : Promise.resolve(null),
      ]);
      // Blind is for counting: a posted count, for whoever may see the records, with them.
      const count = read && read.status !== 'Draft' && read.blind && seesCosts ? await firstValueFrom(this.api.stockCount(id, false)) : read;
      const priced = new Map(costs.map((m) => [m.id, m]));
      const counted = new Set((count?.lines ?? []).map((l) => l.rawMaterialId));
      this.allMaterials = items
        .filter((i) => !i.isArchived || counted.has(i.id))
        .map((i) => ({ ...fromItem(i), ...(priced.get(i.id) ?? {}), category: i.category, isSpotCheckItem: i.isSpotCheckItem }));
      const scope = count?.scope === 'Spot' ? new Set(count.scopeMaterialIds ?? []) : null;
      this.materials.set(scope ? this.allMaterials.filter((m) => scope.has(m.id)) : this.allMaterials);
      this.count.set(count);
      this.tolerance.set(settings?.varianceTolerancePercent ?? 5);
      this.saved.set(count !== null);
      this.kind.set(count?.kind ?? (this.kindParam() === 'Opening' ? 'Opening' : 'Periodic'));
      const units = new Map(this.allMaterials.map((m) => [m.id, this.sizeOf(m)]));
      this.counted.set(Object.fromEntries((count?.lines ?? []).map((l) => [l.rawMaterialId, l.countedQuantity / (units.get(l.rawMaterialId) ?? 1)])));
      this.notes.set(Object.fromEntries((count?.lines ?? []).filter((l) => l.note).map((l) => [l.rawMaterialId, l.note!])));
      if (count) {
        this.saveState.set('Saved');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.error.set(errorMessage(error, 'The count could not be loaded.'));
    } finally {
      this.loading.set(false);
    }
  }
}

function readBlindChoice(): boolean {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(blindKey) === '1';
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

// A count sheet's material as the rest of the page reads one: no cost, no stock.
function fromItem(item: CountItem): MaterialCost {
  return {
    id: item.id,
    code: item.code,
    name: item.name,
    category: item.category,
    categoryId: item.categoryId,
    unit: item.unit,
    purchaseUnit: item.purchaseUnit,
    purchaseUnitSize: item.purchaseUnitSize,
    costPerPurchaseUnit: null,
    defaultYieldPercent: 100,
    quantityOnHand: 0,
    reorderLevel: 0,
    stockValue: null,
    lastPurchaseCostPerPurchaseUnit: null,
    lastPurchasedAtUtc: null,
    costPerUnit: null,
    kind: item.isPrepItem ? 'Prep' : 'Purchased',
    isSpotCheckItem: item.isSpotCheckItem,
    kitchenStationId: item.kitchenStationId ?? null,
  } as MaterialCost;
}

// Text written into the printed sheet, as text.
function escape(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[c]!);
}
```


**حسب قسم المطبخ:** صفحة الجرد تبدأ جردًا جزئيًا لقسم (`startStation`) من `presets.stations`، وورقة الجرد لها فلتر "حسب قسم المطبخ" يقصر الأقسام المعروضة **وكشف الجرد الأعمى المطبوع** على القسم (`sections` هي ما يُطبع)، واسم القسم في عنوان الكشف. والخامات والمصنعات لها عمود قسم بقائمة في كل صف وفلتر، وزر "Station for the N shown" يعيّن القسم لكل المعروض. والهالك له "القسم المسؤول" يبدأ بقسم الخامة.

### 13.1 المواقع والتحويلات الداخلية

`StockPlaces` (خدمة واحدة للتطبيق): مواقع الفرع، و `shown` صحيحة فقط مع نمط له مواقع وموقع واحد على الأقل؛ ولا تطلب شيئًا من الـ API في المساحة المفتوحة (تصل لـ `StockApi` عبر `Injector` عند الحاجة فقط). و `<app-location-select>` لا يرسم شيئًا إن لم تظهر المواقع، ويبدأ بالمخزن الرئيسي (أو "كل الفرع" في الجرد)، و `locationParam` تحوّل "كل الفرع" إلى null. يظهر في: الفاتورة ("موقع الاستلام")، ويومية المشتريات، والإنتاج ("موقع التصنيع")، والهالك، ووجبات العاملين، وبدء الجرد ("مكان الجرد"، ويُرسل لورقة الجرد كـ `?location=` مع أول حفظ، واسمه أعلى الورقة).
