  styles: `
    .wide { min-width: 220px; }
    .small { width: 130px; }
    .full { width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; }
    .short { color: var(--mat-sys-error); font-weight: 600; }
  `,
})
export class ReceiveDialog {
  protected readonly data = inject<ReceiveDialogData>(MAT_DIALOG_DATA);
  private readonly ref = inject(MatDialogRef<ReceiveDialog, Receipt>);
  private readonly api = inject(InterBranchApi);
  protected readonly places = inject(StockPlaces);
  private readonly id = crypto.randomUUID();
  private readonly sizes = this.data.shipment.lines.map((l) => unitOf(l.unit, l.purchaseUnitSize));

  protected readonly to = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly notes = signal('');
  protected readonly received = signal<(number | null)[]>(this.data.shipment.lines.map((l, i) => l.quantity / this.sizes[i].size));
  protected readonly saving = signal(false);
  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);

  protected readonly anyShort = computed(() => this.data.shipment.lines.some((_, i) => this.short(i) > 1e-9));
  protected readonly tooMuch = computed(() => this.received().some((r, i) => (Number(r) || 0) > this.sent(i) + 1e-9));
  protected readonly ready = computed(
    () => !!this.to() && !this.tooMuch() && this.received().every((r) => r !== null && `${r}` !== '' && Number(r) >= 0)
      && (!this.anyShort() || !!this.notes().trim()),
  );

  constructor() {
    void this.places.load(true).then(() => this.to.set(this.places.mainStore()?.id ?? null));
  }

  protected label(i: number): string {
    return this.sizes[i].label;
  }

  protected sent(i: number): number {
    return this.data.shipment.lines[i].quantity / this.sizes[i].size;
  }

  protected short(i: number): number {
    return Math.max(this.sent(i) - (Number(this.received()[i]) || 0), 0);
  }

  // At the price billed for it, as the branch's invoice keeps it.
  protected loss(i: number): number {
    const price = this.data.shipment.lines[i].transferUnitPrice;
    return price === null ? 0 : this.short(i) * this.sizes[i].size * price;
  }

  protected set(i: number, value: number | null): void {
    this.received.update((all) => all.map((r, j) => (j === i ? value : r)));
  }

  protected async submit(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.ready()) {
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);
    try {
      const made = await firstValueFrom(
        this.api.receive({
          id: this.id,
          shipmentId: this.data.shipment.id,
          toLocationId: this.to(),
          lines: this.data.shipment.lines.map((l, i) => ({ rawMaterialId: l.rawMaterialId, receivedQuantity: Number(this.received()[i]) * this.sizes[i].size })),
          notes: this.notes().trim() || null,
        }),
      );
      this.ref.close(made);
    } catch (error) {
      this.error.set(errorMessage(error, 'The shipment could not be received.'));
    } finally {
      this.saving.set(false);
    }
  }
}

export function openRequisitionDialog(dialog: MatDialog, data: RequisitionDialogData): Promise<Requisition | undefined> {
  return firstValueFrom(
    dialog.open<RequisitionDialog, RequisitionDialogData, Requisition>(RequisitionDialog, { data, width: '820px', maxWidth: '95vw', autoFocus: 'dialog' }).afterClosed(),
  );
}

export function openDispatchDialog(dialog: MatDialog, data: DispatchDialogData): Promise<Shipment | undefined> {
  return firstValueFrom(
    dialog.open<DispatchDialog, DispatchDialogData, Shipment>(DispatchDialog, { data, width: '960px', maxWidth: '95vw', autoFocus: 'dialog' }).afterClosed(),
  );
}

export function openReceiveDialog(dialog: MatDialog, data: ReceiveDialogData): Promise<Receipt | undefined> {
  return firstValueFrom(
    dialog.open<ReceiveDialog, ReceiveDialogData, Receipt>(ReceiveDialog, { data, width: '760px', maxWidth: '95vw', autoFocus: 'dialog' }).afterClosed(),
  );
}

```ts
import { UnitOfMeasure, countUnit } from '../../core/costing/costing.api';
import { Receipt, Requisition, Shipment, requisitionStatusLabels } from '../../core/costing/inter-branch.api';

// The central kitchen hub's papers: a requisition's slip and its WhatsApp message (quantities and
// units only, never a price), and a dispatch's internal sales invoice (with prices, for whoever sees
// them) or its delivery note (without). Each in a window of its own, so it prints as a paper.

// A quantity kept in grams, millilitres or pieces, as the material is counted: "4 kg", "250 ml".
export function shownQuantity(quantity: number, unit: UnitOfMeasure | string, purchaseUnitSize: number): string {
  const counted = countUnit(unit as UnitOfMeasure, purchaseUnitSize);
  return `${(quantity / counted.size).toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 3 })} ${counted.label}`;
}

function day(iso: string | null): string {
  return iso ? new Date(`${iso}T00:00:00`).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }) : '';
}

export function escapeHtml(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[c]!);
}

// The requisition as a WhatsApp message to the kitchen: what is asked, how much, by when.
export function requisitionWhatsApp(requisition: Requisition, company: string): string {
  const due = day(requisition.requestedDeliveryDate);
  return [
    `*${company}* · طلب بضاعة *${requisition.number}*`,
    `Requisition *${requisition.number}*: ${requisition.requestingBranch} → ${requisition.supplyingBranch}`,
    '',
    ...requisition.lines.map(
      (l, i) => `${i + 1}. ${l.material} — ${shownQuantity(l.requestedQuantity, l.unit, l.purchaseUnitSize)}${l.notes ? ` (${l.notes})` : ''}`,
    ),
    '',
    due ? `Wanted by · مطلوب يوم: ${due}` : null,
    requisition.notes ? `Notes · ملاحظات: ${requisition.notes}` : null,
    '',
    'Please confirm · برجاء التأكيد 🙏',
  ]
    .filter((l) => l !== null)
    .join('\n')
    // No date and no notes: one blank line, not two.
    .replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
}

const paperStyle = `
  body { font: 12px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; margin: 24px; color: #111; }
  h1 { font-size: 18px; margin: 0 0 4px; } p { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #333; }
  .void { color: #b00020; font-weight: 700; }
  .head { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 4px 24px; margin: 12px 0 16px; }
  table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; } th, td { border: 1px solid #999; padding: 6px 8px; text-align: start; }
  th { background: #eee; } td.num, th.num { text-align: end; }
  tfoot td { font-weight: 600; }
  .signatures { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 48px; margin-top: 48px; }
  .signatures div { border-top: 1px solid #111; padding-top: 4px; }
  @page { margin: 14mm; }`;

function write(target: Window, title: string, body: string): void {
  target.document.write(`<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>${escapeHtml(title)}</title><style>${paperStyle}</style></head><body>${body}</body></html>`);
  target.document.close();
  target.focus();
  target.print();
}

// The requisition slip (إذن طلب بضاعة): what the branch asks of the kitchen, for the kitchen to fill.
export function printRequisition(target: Window, requisition: Requisition, company: string): void {
  const status = requisitionStatusLabels[requisition.status];
  const rows = requisition.lines
    .map(
      (l) =>
        `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(l.code ?? '')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(l.material)}</td>` +
        `<td class="num">${escapeHtml(shownQuantity(l.requestedQuantity, l.unit, l.purchaseUnitSize))}</td>` +
        `<td class="num">${escapeHtml(shownQuantity(l.dispatchedQuantity, l.unit, l.purchaseUnitSize))}</td><td>${escapeHtml(l.notes ?? '')}</td></tr>`,
    )
    .join('');
  write(
    target,
    `${requisition.number} · طلب بضاعة`,
    `<h1>${escapeHtml(company)} — Requisition · أمر طلب بضاعة من الفرع</h1>
    ${requisition.status === 'Cancelled' ? '<p class="void">CANCELLED · ملغي</p>' : ''}
    <div class="head">
      <div><strong>Number · الرقم:</strong> ${escapeHtml(requisition.number)}</div>
      <div><strong>Day · التاريخ:</strong> ${escapeHtml(day(requisition.requestDate))}</div>
      <div><strong>From · الفرع الطالب:</strong> ${escapeHtml(requisition.requestingBranch)}</div>
      <div><strong>To · المورد الداخلي:</strong> ${escapeHtml(requisition.supplyingBranch)}</div>
      <div><strong>Wanted by · مطلوب يوم:</strong> ${escapeHtml(day(requisition.requestedDeliveryDate) || '—')}</div>
      <div><strong>Status · الحالة:</strong> ${escapeHtml(`${status.en} · ${status.ar}`)}</div>
      <div><strong>Asked by · بواسطة:</strong> ${escapeHtml(requisition.createdBy)}</div>
      ${requisition.notes ? `<div><strong>Notes · ملاحظات:</strong> ${escapeHtml(requisition.notes)}</div>` : ''}
    </div>
    <table><thead><tr><th>Code · الكود</th><th>Material · الخامة</th><th class="num">Asked · المطلوب</th><th class="num">Sent · المصروف</th>
      <th>Note · ملاحظة</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>
    <div class="signatures"><div>Asked by · الطالب</div><div>Approved by the kitchen · اعتماد المطبخ المركزي</div></div>`,
  );
}

// The dispatch's paper: its internal sales invoice (إذن صرف وفاتورة بيع داخلية) with what each line
// costs and is billed at, or, for whoever does not see prices, its delivery note (إذن تسليم).
export function printShipment(target: Window, shipment: Shipment, company: string, money: (n: number) => string): void {
  const priced = shipment.totalTransferRevenue !== null;
  const rows = shipment.lines
    .map((l) => {
      const size = countUnit(l.unit, l.purchaseUnitSize).size;
      return (
        `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(l.code ?? '')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(l.material)}</td>` +
        `<td class="num">${escapeHtml(shownQuantity(l.quantity, l.unit, l.purchaseUnitSize))}</td>` +
        (priced
          ? `<td class="num">${escapeHtml(l.transferUnitPrice === null ? '' : money(l.transferUnitPrice * size))}</td>` +
            `<td class="num">${escapeHtml(l.lineRevenue === null ? '' : money(l.lineRevenue))}</td>`
          : '') +
        `<td class="num">${l.receivedQuantity === null ? '' : escapeHtml(shownQuantity(l.receivedQuantity, l.unit, l.purchaseUnitSize))}</td></tr>`
      );
    })
    .join('');
  const title = priced ? 'Internal sales invoice · فاتورة بيع داخلية' : 'Delivery note · إذن تسليم';
  write(
    target,
    `${shipment.number} · ${priced ? 'فاتورة بيع داخلية' : 'إذن تسليم'}`,
    `<h1>${escapeHtml(company)} — ${title}</h1>
    ${shipment.status === 'Voided' ? `<p class="void">VOIDED · ملغي${shipment.voidedBy ? ' — ' + escapeHtml(shipment.voidedBy) : ''}</p>` : ''}
    <div class="head">
      <div><strong>Number · الرقم:</strong> ${escapeHtml(shipment.number)}</div>
      <div><strong>Day · التاريخ:</strong> ${escapeHtml(day(shipment.dispatchDate))}</div>
      <div><strong>From · من:</strong> ${escapeHtml(`${shipment.supplyingBranch} — ${shipment.fromLocation}`)}</div>
      <div><strong>To · إلى:</strong> ${escapeHtml(shipment.receivingBranch)}</div>
      <div><strong>Requisition · الطلب:</strong> ${escapeHtml(shipment.requisitionNumber ?? 'Direct dispatch · صرف مباشر')}</div>
      <div><strong>Sent by · بواسطة:</strong> ${escapeHtml(shipment.createdBy)}</div>
      ${shipment.notes ? `<div><strong>Notes · ملاحظات:</strong> ${escapeHtml(shipment.notes)}</div>` : ''}
      ${priced ? '<div><strong>Inter-company · بين فروع الشركة</strong></div>' : ''}
    </div>
    <table><thead><tr><th>Code · الكود</th><th>Material · الخامة</th><th class="num">Sent · المرسل</th>
      ${priced ? '<th class="num">Price · سعر التحويل</th><th class="num">Total · الإجمالي</th>' : ''}
      <th class="num">Received · المستلم</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
      ${priced ? `<tfoot><tr><td colspan="4">Total · الإجمالي</td><td class="num">${escapeHtml(money(shipment.totalTransferRevenue!))}</td><td></td></tr></tfoot>` : ''}
    </table>
    <div class="signatures"><div>Sent by the kitchen · المسلِّم</div><div>Received by the branch · المستلِم</div></div>`,
  );
}

// The branch's receipt and its internal purchase invoice (فاتورة مشتريات داخلية): what was sent,
// what came in and what was short, with the price billed for whoever sees prices.
export function printReceipt(target: Window, receipt: Receipt, company: string, money: (n: number) => string): void {
  const priced = receipt.totalBilled !== null;
  const rows = receipt.lines
    .map(
      (l) =>
        `<tr><td>${escapeHtml(l.code ?? '')}</td><td>${escapeHtml(l.material)}</td>` +
        `<td class="num">${escapeHtml(shownQuantity(l.dispatchedQuantity, l.unit, l.purchaseUnitSize))}</td>` +
        `<td class="num">${escapeHtml(shownQuantity(l.receivedQuantity, l.unit, l.purchaseUnitSize))}</td>` +
        `<td class="num">${l.shortQuantity > 0 ? escapeHtml(shownQuantity(l.shortQuantity, l.unit, l.purchaseUnitSize)) : ''}</td>` +
        (priced
          ? `<td class="num">${escapeHtml(l.lineTotal === null ? '' : money(l.lineTotal))}</td>` +
            `<td class="num">${escapeHtml(l.transitLoss ? money(l.transitLoss) : '')}</td>`
          : '') +
        '</tr>',
    )
    .join('');
  write(
    target,
    `${receipt.number} · فاتورة مشتريات داخلية`,
    `<h1>${escapeHtml(company)} — ${priced ? 'Internal purchase invoice · فاتورة مشتريات داخلية' : 'Goods received note · إذن استلام'}</h1>
    ${receipt.status === 'Voided' ? `<p class="void">VOIDED · ملغي${receipt.voidedBy ? ' — ' + escapeHtml(receipt.voidedBy) : ''}</p>` : ''}
    <div class="head">
      <div><strong>Number · الرقم:</strong> ${escapeHtml(receipt.number)}</div>
      <div><strong>Day · التاريخ:</strong> ${escapeHtml(day(receipt.receiptDate))}</div>
      <div><strong>From · من:</strong> ${escapeHtml(receipt.supplyingBranch)}</div>
      <div><strong>Into · إلى:</strong> ${escapeHtml(`${receipt.receivingBranch} — ${receipt.toLocation}`)}</div>
      <div><strong>Shipment · الشحنة:</strong> ${escapeHtml(receipt.shipmentNumber)}</div>
      <div><strong>Requisition · الطلب:</strong> ${escapeHtml(receipt.requisitionNumber ?? 'Direct dispatch · صرف مباشر')}</div>
      <div><strong>Received by · بواسطة:</strong> ${escapeHtml(receipt.createdBy)}</div>
      ${receipt.notes ? `<div><strong>Notes · ملاحظات:</strong> ${escapeHtml(receipt.notes)}</div>` : ''}
    </div>
    <table><thead><tr><th>Code · الكود</th><th>Material · الخامة</th><th class="num">Sent · المرسل</th><th class="num">Received · المستلم</th>
      <th class="num">Short · العجز</th>${priced ? '<th class="num">Billed · المفوتر</th><th class="num">Transit loss · عجز النقل</th>' : ''}</tr></thead>
      <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
      ${priced ? `<tfoot><tr><td colspan="5">Total · الإجمالي</td><td class="num">${escapeHtml(money(receipt.totalBilled!))}</td>`
        + `<td class="num">${escapeHtml(receipt.totalTransitLoss ? money(receipt.totalTransitLoss) : '')}</td></tr></tfoot>` : ''}
    </table>
    <div class="signatures"><div>Delivered by · المسلِّم</div><div>Received by · المستلِم</div></div>`,
  );
}

                <td class="num">{{ worth(line) === null ? '' : (worth(line) | money) }}</td>
                <td>
                  <button mat-icon-button (click)="remove(i)" [disabled]="lines().length === 1" aria-label="Remove line"><mat-icon>delete</mat-icon></button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            }
          </tbody>
          <tfoot>
            <tr>
              <td><button mat-button (click)="add()"><mat-icon>add</mat-icon> Add line</button></td>
              <td colspan="3"></td>
              <td class="num">{{ total() | money }}</td>
              <td></td>
            </tr>
          </tfoot>
        </table>
      </div>
      <div class="toolbar actions">
        <app-location-select [(value)]="location" label="Thrown away from · موقع الهالك" ariaLabel="Thrown away from" />
        <span class="spacer"></span>
        <button mat-flat-button (click)="save()" [disabled]="!ready() || saving()"><mat-icon>delete_sweep</mat-icon> Record waste</button>
      </div>

      <h2 class="recent">Last 30 days <span class="inline-ar">آخر ٣٠ يومًا</span></h2>
      <div class="toolbar smart">
        <app-search-field [(value)]="historySearch" placeholder="Material or who recorded it · الخامة أو المسجل" />
        <div class="pills">
          <app-filter-select label="Why · السبب" icon="help" [options]="reasonFilters()" [(value)]="historyReason" />
          <app-filter-select label="Station · القسم" icon="soup_kitchen" [options]="stationFilters()" [(value)]="historyStation" />
          <app-sort-control [options]="wasteSorts" [(sort)]="historySort" />
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="table-wrap">
        <table class="grid">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>When<span class="ar">التاريخ</span></th>
              <th>Material<span class="ar">الخامة</span></th>
              <th class="num">Quantity<span class="ar">الكمية</span></th>
              <th>Why<span class="ar">السبب</span></th>
              <th>Station<span class="ar">القسم المسؤول</span></th>
              <th>By<span class="ar">بواسطة</span></th>
              <th class="num">Worth<span class="ar">القيمة</span></th>
              <th class="num"><span class="visually-hidden">Actions</span></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (entry of shownRecent(); track entry.spoilageId) {
              @for (l of entry.lines; track l.rawMaterialId; let first = $first) {
                <tr [class.pending-deletion]="!!pendingOf(entry)" [class.focused]="entry.spoilageId === spoilage()" [attr.id]="first ? 'spoilage-' + entry.spoilageId : null">
                  <td>
                    @if (first) {
                      {{ entry.recordedAtUtc | date: 'd MMM, HH:mm' }}
                      @if (pendingOf(entry); as p) {

                        <div class="muted note-small">by {{ p.requestedBy }}</div>
                      }
                    }
                  </td>
                  <td>{{ l.material }}</td>
                  <td class="num">{{ l.quantity / unitFor(l).size | number: '1.0-3' }} {{ unitFor(l).label }}</td>
                  <td>{{ l.reason }}</td>
                  <td class="muted">{{ stations.label(l.responsibleStationId) }}</td>
                  <td>{{ first ? entry.recordedBy : '' }}</td>
                  <td class="num">{{ l.value === null ? 'No price' : (l.value | money) }}</td>
                  <td class="num">
                    @if (first) {
                      @if (pendingOf(entry)) {
                        <mat-icon class="locked" matTooltip="Waiting for a manager's approval" aria-label="Locked: deletion requested">lock_clock</mat-icon>
                      } @else {
                        <button mat-icon-button class="danger" (click)="voidEntry(entry)" matTooltip="Delete (void)" aria-label="Delete this waste entry">
                          <mat-icon>delete</mat-icon>
                        </button>
                      }
                    }
                  </td>
                </tr>
              }
            } @empty {
              <tr><td colspan="7" class="muted">Nothing recorded.</td></tr>
            }
          </tbody>
          @if (recent().length) {
            <tfoot>
              <tr>
                <td colspan="5">Total · الإجمالي</td>
                <td class="num">{{ recentTotal() | money }}</td>
                <td></td>
              </tr>
            </tfoot>
          }
        </table>
      </div>

      <h2 class="recent">Breakage, last 30 days <span class="inline-ar">الكسر</span></h2>
      <p class="muted tiny">Plates, glasses and other consumables broken, at their cost: a cost of the day, no stock moves.</p>
      <form class="breakage-form" (ngSubmit)="recordBreakage()" aria-label="Record breakage">
        <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="what">
          <mat-label>What broke · الصنف</mat-label>
          <input matInput name="bDescription" [(ngModel)]="breakageDraft.description" maxlength="150" required />
        </mat-form-field>
        <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="small">
          <mat-label>How many · العدد</mat-label>
          <input matInput type="number" min="1" step="1" name="bQuantity" [(ngModel)]="breakageDraft.quantity" required />
        </mat-form-field>
        <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="small">
          <mat-label>A piece's cost · تكلفة القطعة</mat-label>
          <input matInput type="number" min="0" step="0.01" name="bCost" [(ngModel)]="breakageDraft.unitCost" />
        </mat-form-field>
        <app-employee-picker [employees]="activeStaff()" [(value)]="breakageDraft.employeeId" [none]="true" noneLabel="No one · لا أحد"
          label="Whose · بواسطة من" ariaLabel="Who broke it" />
        <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="reason">
          <mat-label>Notes · ملاحظات</mat-label>
          <input matInput name="bNotes" [(ngModel)]="breakageDraft.notes" maxlength="300" />
        </mat-form-field>
        <button mat-flat-button type="submit" [disabled]="savingBreakage() || !breakageDraft.description.trim() || !(breakageDraft.quantity >= 1)">
          <mat-icon>add</mat-icon> Record breakage <span class="inline-ar">تسجيل كسر</span>
        </button>
      </form>
      <div class="table-wrap">
        <table class="grid" aria-label="Breakage">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Day<span class="ar">اليوم</span></th>
              <th>What broke<span class="ar">الصنف</span></th>
              <th class="num">How many<span class="ar">العدد</span></th>
              <th>Who broke it<span class="ar">بواسطة من</span></th>
              <th class="num">Cost<span class="ar">التكلفة</span></th>
              <th>By<span class="ar">بواسطة</span></th>
              <th></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (b of breakage(); track b.id) {
              <tr [class.voided]="b.isVoided">
                <td class="nowrap">{{ b.businessDate | date: 'd MMM' }}</td>
                <td>
                  <strong>{{ b.description }}</strong>
                  @if (b.notes) {
                    <div class="muted tiny">{{ b.notes }}</div>
                  }
                </td>
                <td class="num">{{ b.quantity }}</td>
                <td>{{ b.employeeName ?? '—' }}</td>
                <td class="num">{{ b.unitCost === null ? 'Cost not known' : (b.cost | money) }}</td>
                <td class="muted tiny">{{ b.recordedBy }}</td>
                <td class="actions">
                  @if (b.isVoided) {
                    <span class="muted tiny">Voided · ملغي</span>
                  } @else if (approvals.pendingFor(b.id); as request) {
                    <span class="pending-badge">Void requested<span class="ar">طلب إلغاء</span></span>
                  } @else {
                    <button mat-icon-button (click)="voidBreakage(b)" [attr.aria-label]="'Void the breakage of ' + b.description" matTooltip="Void · إلغاء">
                      <mat-icon>undo</mat-icon>
                    </button>
                  }
                </td>
              </tr>
            } @empty {
              <tr><td colspan="7" class="muted">Nothing broken.</td></tr>
            }
          </tbody>
          @if (breakage().length) {
            <tfoot>
              <tr>
                <td colspan="4">Total · الإجمالي</td>
                <td class="num">{{ breakageTotal() | money }}</td>
                <td colspan="2"></td>
              </tr>
            </tfoot>
          }
        </table>
      </div>
    }
  `,
  styleUrl: './costing.scss',
  styles: `
    tr.focused td {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-primary) 10%, transparent);

      min-width: 200px;
      width: 100%;

      width: 140px;
    }

      width: 220px;
    }
    .actions {
      margin-top: 12px;
    }
    .recent {
      margin: 24px 0 8px;
      font: var(--mat-sys-title-medium);
    }
    .tiny {
      font-size: 0.85em;
    }
    .nowrap {
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

      text-decoration: line-through;
      color: var(--mat-sys-on-surface-variant);

      color: var(--mat-sys-error);

      font-size: 0.85em;

      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
    }
  `,
})
export class WastePage {
  private readonly api = inject(CostingApi);
  private readonly notify = inject(NotifyService);
  protected readonly approvals = inject(Approvals);
  private readonly businessDay = inject(BusinessDay);

  protected readonly reasons = [
    { en: 'Expired', ar: 'منتهي الصلاحية' },
    { en: 'Spoiled', ar: 'تالف' },
    { en: 'Dropped or broken', ar: 'سقط أو انكسر' },
    { en: 'Damaged packaging', ar: 'تلف العبوة' },
    { en: 'Other', ar: 'أخرى' },
  ];

  // Opened from a stock card: the entry it names, marked, the history reaching back a year for it.
  readonly spoilage = input<string | undefined>(undefined);

  protected readonly materials = signal<MaterialCost[]>([]);
  protected readonly recent = signal<SpoilageEntry[]>([]);
  protected readonly loading = signal(true);
  protected readonly saving = signal(false);
  // Where it was thrown away (with locations only).
  protected readonly location = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly lines = signal<Line[]>([this.blank()]);

  // One entry, one id: a retry after a lost answer records it once. A new one after each save.
  private spoilageId = crypto.randomUUID();

  protected readonly total = computed(() => this.lines().reduce((sum, l) => sum + (this.worth(l) ?? 0), 0));
  protected readonly recentTotal = computed(() =>
    this.shownRecent().reduce((sum, e) => sum + e.lines.reduce((lines, l) => lines + (l.value ?? 0), 0), 0),
  );

  // The history as searched: each entry with only its lines that match, by material or who recorded
  // it, and the reason chosen; by date or by what its lines were worth.
  protected readonly historySearch = signal('');
  protected readonly historyReason = signal('');
  protected readonly historyStation = signal('');
  protected readonly stations = inject(Stations);
  protected readonly stationFilters = computed<FilterOption[]>(() =>
    this.stations.filter(this.recent().flatMap((e) => e.lines), (l) => l.responsibleStationId),
  );
  protected readonly wasteSorts = wasteSorts;
  protected readonly historySort = signal<SortState<WasteSort>>({ key: 'date', direction: -1 });

  protected readonly reasonFilters = computed<FilterOption[]>(() => {
    const lines = this.recent().flatMap((e) => e.lines);
    const known = new Set(this.reasons.map((r) => r.en));
    return [
      { value: '', label: 'All · الكل', count: lines.length },
      ...this.reasons.filter((r) => r.en !== 'Other').map((r) => ({ value: r.en, label: `${r.en} · ${r.ar}`, count: lines.filter((l) => l.reason === r.en).length })),
      { value: 'Other', label: 'Other · أخرى', count: lines.filter((l) => !known.has(l.reason ?? '') || l.reason === 'Other').length },
    ];
  });

  protected readonly shownRecent = computed(() => {
    const reason = this.historyReason();
    const known = new Set(this.reasons.map((r) => r.en).filter((r) => r !== 'Other'));
    const entries = this.recent()
      .map((e) => ({
        ...e,
        lines: e.lines.filter(
          (l) =>
            smartMatch(this.historySearch(), l.material, l.reason, e.recordedBy) &&
            this.stations.matches(this.historyStation(), l.responsibleStationId) &&
            (!reason || (reason === 'Other' ? !known.has(l.reason ?? '') : l.reason === reason)),
        ),
      }))
      .filter((e) => e.lines.length > 0);
    return sortItems(entries, this.historySort(), (e, key) =>
      key === 'worth' ? e.lines.reduce((sum, l) => sum + (l.value ?? 0), 0) : e.recordedAtUtc,
    );
  });
  private readonly menuSales = inject(MenuSalesApi);
  protected readonly breakage = signal<BreakageEntry[]>([]);
  protected readonly staff = signal<Employee[]>([]);
  protected readonly activeStaff = computed(() => this.staff().filter((e) => e.isActive));
  protected readonly savingBreakage = signal(false);
  protected breakageDraft = this.blankBreakage();
  // One entry, one id: a retry after a lost answer records it once.
  private breakageId = crypto.randomUUID();
  protected readonly breakageTotal = computed(() => this.breakage().filter((b) => !b.isVoided).reduce((sum, b) => sum + b.cost, 0));

  protected readonly ready = computed(() => {
    const lines = this.lines();
    const ids = lines.map((l) => l.rawMaterialId);
    return (
      lines.every((l) => l.rawMaterialId && (l.quantity ?? 0) > 0 && this.reasonOf(l)) && new Set(ids).size === ids.length
    );
  });

  constructor() {
    void this.load();
    void this.stations.load();
  }

  // The station held to account for a line: the one chosen, else its material's own ('' none).
  protected stationFor(line: Line): string {
    return line.stationId !== undefined ? (line.stationId ?? '') : (this.material(line)?.kitchenStationId ?? '');
  }

  protected unitOf(line: Line): string {
    const material = this.material(line);
    return material ? countUnit(material.unit, material.purchaseUnitSize).label : '';
  }

  // At today's average cost, as the server will value it.
  protected worth(line: Line): number | null {
    const material = this.material(line);
    if (!material || material.costPerUnit === null || !line.quantity) {
      return null;
    }
    return line.quantity * countUnit(material.unit, material.purchaseUnitSize).size * material.costPerUnit;
  }

  protected change(index: number, patch: Partial<Line>): void {
    this.lines.update((lines) => lines.map((line, i) => (i === index ? { ...line, ...patch } : line)));
  }

  protected add(): void {
    this.lines.update((lines) => [...lines, this.blank()]);
  }

  protected remove(index: number): void {
    this.lines.update((lines) => lines.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  }

  protected async save(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.ready()) {
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    try {
      const lines = this.lines().map((l) => ({
        rawMaterialId: l.rawMaterialId!,
        quantity: l.quantity! * countUnit(this.material(l)!.unit, this.material(l)!.purchaseUnitSize).size,
        reason: this.reasonOf(l),
        responsibleStationId: this.stationFor(l) || null,
      }));
      await firstValueFrom(this.api.recordSpoilage(this.spoilageId, lines, locationParam(this.location())));
      this.notify.info('Waste recorded.');
      this.lines.set([this.blank()]);
      this.spoilageId = crypto.randomUUID();
      await this.load();
    } catch (error) {
      this.notify.error(error, 'The waste could not be recorded.');
    } finally {
      this.saving.set(false);
    }
  }

  protected unitFor(line: { unit: MaterialCost['unit']; purchaseUnitSize: number }): { label: string; size: number } {
    return countUnit(line.unit, line.purchaseUnitSize);
  }

  protected async recordBreakage(): Promise<void> {
    const draft = this.breakageDraft;
    if (!draft.description.trim() || !(draft.quantity >= 1)) {
      return;
    }
    this.savingBreakage.set(true);
    try {
      await firstValueFrom(this.menuSales.recordBreakage({
        id: this.breakageId, date: await this.businessDay.today(), description: draft.description.trim(), quantity: draft.quantity,
        unitCost: draft.unitCost === null || draft.unitCost === undefined || `${draft.unitCost}` === '' ? null : Number(draft.unitCost),
        employeeId: draft.employeeId, notes: draft.notes.trim() || null,
      }));
      this.notify.info('Breakage recorded.');
      this.breakageDraft = this.blankBreakage();
      this.breakageId = crypto.randomUUID();
      await this.load();
    } catch (error) {
      this.notify.error(error, 'The breakage could not be recorded.');
    } finally {
      this.savingBreakage.set(false);
    }
  }

  // Voided for a manager; asked of one for anyone else.
  protected async voidBreakage(entry: BreakageEntry): Promise<void> {
    if ((await this.approvals.delete('Breakage', entry.id, `the breakage of ${entry.quantity} × ${entry.description}`)) === 'Applied') {
      await this.load();
    }
  }

  private blankBreakage(): { description: string; quantity: number; unitCost: number | null; employeeId: string | null; notes: string } {
    return { description: '', quantity: 1, unitCost: null, employeeId: null, notes: '' };
  }

  private reasonOf(line: Line): string {
    return line.reason === 'Other' ? line.other.trim() : line.reason;
  }

  private material(line: Line): MaterialCost | undefined {
    return this.materials().find((m) => m.id === line.rawMaterialId);
  }

  private blank(): Line {
    return { rawMaterialId: null, quantity: null, reason: 'Expired', other: '' };
  }

  protected pendingOf(entry: SpoilageEntry): ApprovalRequest | undefined {
    return this.approvals.pendingFor(entry.spoilageId);
  }

  // Voided for a manager (its stock goes back); asked of one for anyone else.
  protected async voidEntry(entry: SpoilageEntry): Promise<void> {
    const what = `the waste of ${new Date(entry.recordedAtUtc).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })}`;
    if ((await this.approvals.delete('Waste', entry.spoilageId, what)) === 'Applied') {
      await this.load();
    }
  }

  private async load(): Promise<void> {
    this.error.set(null);
    void this.approvals.refresh();
    try {
      const focus = this.spoilage();
      const [materials, recent] = await Promise.all([firstValueFrom(this.api.materials()), firstValueFrom(this.api.spoilage(focus ? 366 : 30))]);
      this.materials.set(materials);
      this.recent.set(recent);
      if (focus) {
        setTimeout(() => document.getElementById(`spoilage-${focus}`)?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }));
      }
    } catch (error) {
      this.error.set(errorMessage(error, 'The waste could not be loaded.'));
    } finally {
      this.loading.set(false);
    }
    // Apart, so the spoilage stands without it.
    try {
      const [breakage, staff] = await Promise.all([firstValueFrom(this.menuSales.breakage(30)), firstValueFrom(this.menuSales.staff())]);
      this.breakage.set(breakage);
      this.staff.set(staff);
    } catch {
      this.breakage.set([]);
    }
  }
}
```

})
export class WasteShell {
  protected readonly tabs: SubNavTab[] = [
    { path: 'spoilage', icon: 'delete_sweep', en: 'Spoilage & breakage', ar: 'الهالك والكسر' },

}

`StaffMealsPage`: تسجيل بالطبق (أطباق كاملة من الوصفات) أو بالخامة (كمية × وحدة الجرد)، وجدول الأيام مقابل الحد اليومي (شارة "تجاوز الحد" بالمبلغ الزائد)، وجدول القيود وإلغاؤها بموافقة الهالك. و `?entry=` من كارتة الصنف يُبرز القيد.

import { DatePipe } from '@angular/common';
import { Component, computed, effect, inject, input, signal, untracked } from '@angular/core';
import { FormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { MatButtonModule } from '@angular/material/button';
import { MatButtonToggleModule } from '@angular/material/button-toggle';
import { MatFormFieldModule } from '@angular/material/form-field';
import { MatIconModule } from '@angular/material/icon';
import { MatInputModule } from '@angular/material/input';
import { MatProgressBarModule } from '@angular/material/progress-bar';
import { firstValueFrom } from 'rxjs';
import { AuthService } from '../../core/auth/auth.service';
import { Permissions } from '../../core/auth/permissions';
import {
  CostingApi,
  MaterialCost,
  RecipeCostCard,
  StaffMealEntry,
  StaffMealKind,
  StaffMealReport,
  countUnit,
  staffMealKindLabels,
} from '../../core/costing/costing.api';
import { errorMessage } from '../../core/http/error-message';
import { MoneyPipe } from '../../core/ui/money.pipe';
import { NotifyService } from '../../core/ui/notify.service';
import { ItemPicker, PickItem } from '../shared/item-picker';
import { Approvals } from './approvals';
import { InfoTip } from './info-tip';
import { MaterialPicker } from './material-picker';
import { PeriodBar, periodDays } from './period-bar';
import { LocationSelect, locationParam } from './location-select';

// A line being written: a dish (its recipe, in plates) or a material (in the unit it is counted in).
interface Line {
  by: 'dish' | 'material';
  recipeId: string | null;
  rawMaterialId: string | null;
  quantity: number | null;
}

const kinds: StaffMealKind[] = ['StaffMeal', 'Hospitality', 'RecipeTasting'];

// Staff meals & hospitality (وجبات العاملين والضيافة): what is taken from stock on purpose, logged by
// dish (its recipe's ingredients come off as a sale's do) or by material, apart from spoilage, so the
// kitchen is never charged with them as loss. Each day's staff meals are set against the daily
// budget in Cost settings, and flagged over it. An entry is voided as a waste entry is.
@Component({
  selector: 'app-staff-meals-page',
  imports: [
    LocationSelect,
    DatePipe,
    FormsModule,
    InfoTip,
    ItemPicker,
    MatButtonModule,
    MatButtonToggleModule,
    MatFormFieldModule,
    MatIconModule,
    MatInputModule,
    MatProgressBarModule,
    MaterialPicker,
    MoneyPipe,
    PeriodBar,
  ],
  template: `
    @if (canRecord()) {
      <section class="record" aria-label="Log staff meals and hospitality">
        <h2>Log what was taken · تسجيل <span class="inline-ar">وجبات العاملين والضيافة</span></h2>
        <mat-button-toggle-group [value]="kind()" (change)="kind.set($event.value)" aria-label="What it was">
          @for (k of kinds; track k) {
            <mat-button-toggle [value]="k"><mat-icon aria-hidden="true">{{ labels[k].icon }}</mat-icon> {{ labels[k].en }} <span class="ar">{{ labels[k].ar }}</span></mat-button-toggle>
          }
        </mat-button-toggle-group>
        <div class="lines">
          @for (line of lines(); track $index; let i = $index) {
            <div class="line">
              <mat-button-toggle-group [value]="line.by" (change)="change(i, { by: $event.value, recipeId: null, rawMaterialId: null })" class="by"
                [attr.aria-label]="'By dish or material, line ' + (i + 1)">
                <mat-button-toggle value="dish">Dish · طبق</mat-button-toggle>
                <mat-button-toggle value="material">Material · خامة</mat-button-toggle>
              </mat-button-toggle-group>
              @if (line.by === 'dish') {
                <app-item-picker class="item" [items]="dishes()" [value]="line.recipeId" (valueChange)="change(i, { recipeId: $event })"
                  [label]="'Dish, line ' + (i + 1)" placeholder="A dish or recipe · طبق أو وصفة" />
              } @else {
                <app-material-picker class="item" [materials]="materials()" [value]="line.rawMaterialId"
                  (valueChange)="change(i, { rawMaterialId: $event })" [label]="'Material, line ' + (i + 1)" />
              }
              <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="qty">
                <input matInput type="number" min="0" [step]="line.by === 'dish' ? 1 : 'any'" [ngModel]="line.quantity"
                  (ngModelChange)="change(i, { quantity: $event })" [attr.aria-label]="'Quantity, line ' + (i + 1)" />
                <span matTextSuffix>&nbsp;{{ unitOf(line) }}</span>
              </mat-form-field>
              <button mat-icon-button (click)="remove(i)" [disabled]="lines().length === 1" [attr.aria-label]="'Remove line ' + (i + 1)"><mat-icon>close</mat-icon></button>
            </div>
          }
        </div>
        <div class="toolbar">
          <button mat-button (click)="add()"><mat-icon>add</mat-icon> Another item · صنف آخر</button>
          <mat-form-field subscriptSizing="dynamic" class="note">
            <mat-label>Note · ملاحظة</mat-label>
            <input matInput maxlength="120" [ngModel]="note()" (ngModelChange)="note.set($event)" aria-label="Note" placeholder="Lunch, the owner's guests…" />
          </mat-form-field>
          <app-location-select [(value)]="location" label="Taken from · موقع الصرف" ariaLabel="Taken from" />
          <span class="spacer"></span>
          <button mat-flat-button (click)="record()" [disabled]="!valid() || saving()"><mat-icon>save</mat-icon> Log {{ labels[kind()].en.toLowerCase() }}</button>
        </div>
      </section>
    }

    <div class="toolbar">
      <app-period-bar [(from)]="from" [(to)]="to" />
    </div>
    @if (loading()) {
      <mat-progress-bar mode="indeterminate" />
    }
    @if (error()) {
      <p class="error">{{ error() }}</p>
    } @else if (report(); as r) {
      <div class="tiles">
        <div class="tile key">
          <span class="label">Staff meals · وجبات العاملين <app-info-tip tip="smStaff" /></span>
          <strong>{{ r.staffMeals | money }}</strong>
          <small class="chip">{{ r.dailyBudget === null ? 'No daily budget set' : (r.dailyBudget | money) + ' a day budget' }}</small>
        </div>
        <div class="tile">
          <span class="label">Hospitality · ضيافة وإكراميات <app-info-tip tip="smHospitality" /></span>
          <strong>{{ r.hospitality | money }}</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="tile">
          <span class="label">Recipe tastings · تجارب الوصفات</span>
          <strong>{{ r.recipeTasting | money }}</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="tile" [class.over]="r.daysOverBudget > 0">
          <span class="label">Days over budget · أيام تجاوزت الحد</span>
          <strong>{{ r.daysOverBudget }}</strong>
        </div>
      </div>

      <h3>By day <span class="inline-ar">حسب اليوم</span></h3>
      <div class="table-wrap">
        <table class="grid days">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>Day<span class="ar">اليوم</span></th>
              <th class="num">Staff meals<span class="ar">وجبات العاملين</span></th>
              <th class="num">Hospitality<span class="ar">ضيافة</span></th>
              <th class="num">Tastings<span class="ar">تجارب</span></th>
              <th>Budget<span class="ar">الحد اليومي</span></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (d of r.days; track d.date) {
              <tr>
                <td class="nowrap">{{ d.date | date: 'EEE d MMM' }}</td>
                <td class="num strong">{{ d.staffMeals | money }}</td>
                <td class="num">{{ d.hospitality | money }}</td>
                <td class="num">{{ d.recipeTasting | money }}</td>
                <td>
                  @if (d.overBudget) {
                    <span class="over-badge"><mat-icon aria-hidden="true">warning</mat-icon> Over budget · تجاوز الحد (+{{ d.staffMeals - (r.dailyBudget ?? 0) | money }})</span>
                  } @else if (r.dailyBudget !== null) {
                    <span class="muted small">Within · ضمن الحد</span>
                  }
                </td>
              </tr>
            } @empty {
              <tr><td colspan="5" class="muted">Nothing logged in these days.</td></tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>

      <h3>Entries <span class="inline-ar">السجلات</span></h3>
      <div class="table-wrap">
        <table class="grid entries">
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th>When<span class="ar">الوقت</span></th>
              <th>What<span class="ar">النوع</span></th>
              <th>Items<span class="ar">الأصناف</span></th>
              <th class="num">Cost<span class="ar">التكلفة</span></th>
              <th>By<span class="ar">بواسطة</span></th>
              <th></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            @for (e of r.entries; track e.entryId) {
              <tr [class.highlight]="e.entryId === entry()">
                <td class="nowrap">{{ e.recordedAtUtc | date: 'd MMM, HH:mm' }}</td>
                <td><span class="kind-tag" [class]="e.kind"><mat-icon aria-hidden="true">{{ labels[e.kind].icon }}</mat-icon> {{ labels[e.kind].en }}</span></td>
                <td>
                  @if (e.note) {
                    <strong>{{ e.note }}</strong>
                  }
                  <div class="muted small">{{ itemsOf(e) }}</div>
                </td>
                <td class="num strong">{{ e.value | money }}</td>
                <td>{{ e.recordedBy ?? '—' }}</td>
                <td class="num">
                  @if (approvals.pendingFor(e.entryId)) {
                    <span class="muted small">Void asked · بانتظار الإلغاء</span>
                  } @else if (canRecord()) {
                    <button mat-icon-button (click)="voidEntry(e)" [attr.aria-label]="'Void the entry of ' + (e.recordedAtUtc | date: 'd MMM, HH:mm')"><mat-icon>undo</mat-icon></button>
                  }
                </td>
              </tr>
            } @empty {
              <tr><td colspan="6" class="muted">Nothing logged in these days.</td></tr>
            }
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    }
  `,
  styleUrl: './costing.scss',
  styles: `
    .record {
      margin: 0 0 18px;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border-radius: 16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--app-line);
      background: var(--mat-sys-surface-container-lowest);

      h2 {
        margin: 0 0 10px;
        font: var(--mat-sys-title-small);
      }
      mat-button-toggle-group {
        flex-wrap: wrap;
      }
    }
    .lines {
      display: grid;
      gap: 8px;
      margin: 12px 0;
    }
    .line {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;

      .item {
        flex: 1 1 260px;
      }
      .qty {
        width: 140px;
      }
    }
    .note {
      width: 260px;
    }
    .tile.over {
      border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-warn) 50%, transparent);
      strong {
        color: var(--app-warn);
      }
    }
    .chip {
      justify-self: start;
      padding: 0 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font: var(--mat-sys-label-small);
      background: var(--mat-sys-surface-container-high);
    }
    .over-badge,
    .kind-tag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      padding: 0 8px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font: var(--mat-sys-label-small);
      line-height: 22px;
      white-space: nowrap;

      mat-icon {
        width: 14px;
        height: 14px;
        font-size: 14px;
      }
    }
    .over-badge {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--app-warn) 16%, transparent);
      color: var(--app-warn);
    }
    .kind-tag {
      background: var(--mat-sys-surface-container-high);
    }
    tr.highlight td {
      background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--mat-sys-primary) 8%, transparent);
    }
    h3 {
      margin: 18px 0 8px;
      font: var(--mat-sys-title-small);
    }
    .small {
      font-size: 0.85em;
    }
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .note,
      .line .qty {
        width: 100%;
      }
    }
  `,
})
export class StaffMealsPage {
  private readonly api = inject(CostingApi);
  private readonly notify = inject(NotifyService);
  private readonly auth = inject(AuthService);
  protected readonly approvals = inject(Approvals);
  protected readonly labels = staffMealKindLabels;
  protected readonly kinds = kinds;
  // ?entry= from a stock card: the entry it opened, marked.
  readonly entry = input<string>();

  protected readonly canRecord = computed(() => this.auth.can(Permissions.InventoryManage));
  protected readonly from = signal(periodDays('month').from);
  protected readonly to = signal(periodDays('month').to);
  protected readonly report = signal<StaffMealReport | null>(null);
  protected readonly loading = signal(false);
  protected readonly saving = signal(false);
  // Where it was taken from (with locations only).
  protected readonly location = signal<string | null>(null);
  protected readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);

  protected readonly kind = signal<StaffMealKind>('StaffMeal');
  protected readonly note = signal('');
  protected readonly lines = signal<Line[]>([this.blank()]);
  protected readonly materials = signal<MaterialCost[]>([]);
  private readonly recipes = signal<RecipeCostCard[]>([]);
  private entryId = crypto.randomUUID();

  // Each recipe, by its name and the menu item it sells as.
  protected readonly dishes = computed<PickItem[]>(() =>
    this.recipes()
      .filter((r) => r.recipeId && !r.isDeleted)
      .map((r) => ({ id: r.recipeId!, name: r.recipe, code: r.itemCode || null, kind: 'menu' as const, unit: 'plate', detail: r.category }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name)),
  );

  protected readonly valid = computed(() =>
    this.lines().every(
      (l) =>
        (l.by === 'dish' ? !!l.recipeId : !!l.rawMaterialId) &&
        (l.quantity ?? 0) > 0 &&
        (l.by === 'material' || Number.isInteger(Number(l.quantity))),
    ),
  );

  constructor() {
    effect(() => {
      const [from, to] = [this.from(), this.to()];
      untracked(() => void this.load(from, to));
    });
    void this.loadPickers();
  }

  protected unitOf(line: Line): string {
    if (line.by === 'dish') {
      return 'plates';
    }
    const material = this.materials().find((m) => m.id === line.rawMaterialId);
    return material ? countUnit(material.unit, material.purchaseUnitSize).label : '';
  }

  protected change(i: number, patch: Partial<Line>): void {
    this.lines.update((all) => all.map((l, at) => (at === i ? { ...l, ...patch } : l)));
  }

  protected add(): void {
    this.lines.update((all) => [...all, this.blank()]);
  }

  protected remove(i: number): void {
    this.lines.update((all) => all.filter((_, at) => at !== i));
  }

  protected itemsOf(entry: StaffMealEntry): string {
    return entry.lines.map((l) => `${l.material} ${l.quantity} ${l.purchaseUnit}`).join(', ');
  }

  protected async record(): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.valid()) {
      return;
    }
    this.saving.set(true);
    try {
      const materials = this.materials();
      await firstValueFrom(
        this.api.recordStaffMeal({
          entryId: this.entryId,
          kind: this.kind(),
          locationId: locationParam(this.location()),
          note: this.note().trim() || null,
          lines: this.lines().map((l) => {
            if (l.by === 'dish') {
              return { rawMaterialId: null, recipeId: l.recipeId, quantity: Number(l.quantity) };
            }
            const material = materials.find((m) => m.id === l.rawMaterialId)!;
            return { rawMaterialId: l.rawMaterialId, recipeId: null, quantity: Number(l.quantity) * countUnit(material.unit, material.purchaseUnitSize).size };
          }),
        }),
      );
      this.notify.info(`${this.labels[this.kind()].en} logged. · تم التسجيل.`);
      this.entryId = crypto.randomUUID();
      this.lines.set([this.blank()]);
      this.note.set('');
      await this.load(this.from(), this.to());
    } catch (error) {
      this.notify.error(error, 'It could not be logged.');
    } finally {
      this.saving.set(false);
    }
  }

  // Voided for a manager (its stock goes back); asked of one for anyone else.
  protected async voidEntry(entry: StaffMealEntry): Promise<void> {
    const what = `the ${this.labels[entry.kind].en.toLowerCase()} of ${new Date(entry.recordedAtUtc).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' })}`;
    if ((await this.approvals.delete('Waste', entry.entryId, what)) === 'Applied') {
      await this.load(this.from(), this.to());
    }
  }

  private blank(): Line {
    return { by: 'dish', recipeId: null, rawMaterialId: null, quantity: 1 };
  }

  private async loadPickers(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const [materials, recipes] = await Promise.all([firstValueFrom(this.api.materials()), firstValueFrom(this.api.recipes())]);
      this.materials.set(materials.filter((m) => !m.misplaced));
      this.recipes.set(recipes);
    } catch {
      // The report stands without the pickers; logging waits for them.
    }
  }

  private async load(from: string, to: string): Promise<void> {
    this.loading.set(true);
    this.error.set(null);
    void this.approvals.refresh();
    try {
      this.report.set(await firstValueFrom(this.api.staffMeals(from, to)));
    } catch (error) {
      this.error.set(errorMessage(error, 'The staff meals could not be loaded.'));
    } finally {
      this.loading.set(false);
    }
  }
}
